Scout.Name: Scout
Scout.Description: An early-action specialist who seizes the opening of battle with scouted abilities that can only be used as the first action of a wave, then transform into a lesser related ability afterward. He builds aim quickly, attacks enemies at full health for bonus damage, and is difficult to eliminate before he gets to act.
Scout.Mechanic: Scouted Abilities — Scouted abilities are more powerful only on the very first action of battle. After use, they downgrade permanently to a lesser version for the rest of that battle. The New Beginning capstone restores the scouted condition mid-battle if the Scout's momentum is high enough, allowing him to use the upgraded version again.
Scout.Weapon Mech: initiative bonus, acts sooner in first round

Scout.Major 2: Aimed Momentum – Ranged attack that generates extra aim based on momentum

Scout.Major 4: Delaying Jolt – Ranged attack with delay against stunned target
Scout.Major 5: Flanking Shot – Ranged attack that causes flanked
Scout.Major 6: Lay of the Land – Ranged attack that enhances dodge of team based on aim
Scout.Major 7: Quickening Aim – Ranged attack against single target that consumes aim to quicken self
Scout.Major 8: Rapid Vow – Prepared ranged attack that determines target on preparation.  Quickens scout on preparation and on use
Scout.Major 9: Scouted Arrow Burst – Ranged attack against all enemies.  Deals less damage and requires aim if not first turn
Scout.Major 10: Scouted Chink – Full penetration ranged attack if first attack of battle.  Can proc full penetration with ranged attack after
Scout.Major 11: Scouted Shot – Ranged attack with momentum.  Generates aim if first turn
Scout.Major 12: Speed Shot – Ranged attack that requires momentum and grants aim and deals extra damage based on momentum
Scout.Major 13: Sudden Shot – Ranged attack with sudden

Scout.Move 2: Danger Warning – Grants all allies enhanced dodge until next turn
Scout.Move 3: Momentum Arrow – Ranged attack requiring momentum
Scout.Move 4: Scouted Positions – Flanks and delays all enemies as first action.  Otherwise flanks and delays single enemy
Scout.Move 5: Scouted Preparations – Provides initial bonuses as a period enhancement to all allies on first turn.  Otherwise only provides them until next turn
Scout.Move 6: Speed Screen – Grants haste until next turn and generates aim, must be used as last action
Scout.Minor 1: Momentous Initiative – Gain initial bonuses until beginning of next turn.  Requires momentum
Scout.Minor 2: Perilous Ground – Follows ranged attack, flanks target
Scout.Minor 3: Scouted Aim – Alpha, generates aim.  Also enhances accuracy and quickens self as first action
Scout.Minor 4: Scouted Maneuvers - Quicken all and remove flanked as first action.  Otherwise only quickens and removes flanked from a single target
Scout.Minor 5: Share Momentum – Quicken all allies based on momentum
Scout.Capstone Skill: New Beginning (Momentum Modifier) – If momentum is high enough, gain initial bonuses on turn, including ability to use scouted abilities.

Huntsman.Name: Huntsman
Huntsman.Quote: “A person can turn from predator to prey in just an instant.”
Huntsman.Description: A distance fighter who uses momentum to enhance his arrows and can penetrate armor more effectively the further away his target is. He tracks a specific enemy type, gaining bonuses against others of the same kind as his primary aim target and hitting harder the longer he sustains focus.
Huntsman.Mechanic: Banes — Bane abilities target a specific enemy type. When a bane is applied, it typically affects all enemies that share that type simultaneously — either dealing damage to all of them, granting a debuff to all of them, or granting the Hunter advantages when any ally attacks enemies of that type. Bane abilities typically require or consume aim to use.
Huntsman.Weapon Mech: bonus scales with number of enemies of the hunted type present
Huntsman.Major 1: Bane of the Weakest – Ranged attack that targets a single target.  Deals damage based on bloodlust to target and all enemies of the same type. (Huntsman)
Huntsman.Major 2: Bane Splinter – Prepared ranged attack that determines target on preparation.  Deals damage to all enemies of same type as target (Huntsman)
Huntsman.Major 3: Bleeding Bane – Ranged attack that targets a single enemy.  That enemy and all that share that type take an untyped bleed (Huntsman)
Huntsman.Major 4: Blood Trail – Ranged attack that consumes aim to cause bleed and lowers dodge (Huntsman)
Huntsman.Major 5: Culling Bane – Ranged attack that targets a single enemy.  Requires aim and costs mana.  Attacks and culls all enemies that share that type (Huntsman)
Huntsman.Major 6: Difficult Prey – Ranged attack with enhanced damage based on target’s dodge (Huntsman)
Huntsman.Major 7: Distant Bane – Ranged attack against enemy in back row that also damages all enemies that share type with target. (Huntsman)
Huntsman.Major 8: Distant Shot – Ranged attack that deals more damage to back row and generates aim (Huntsman)
Huntsman.Major 9: Ensnaring Arrow – Ranged attack that causes speed weakness.  Duration is enhanced with aim and the weakness stacks with itself. (Huntsman)
Huntsman.Major 10: Magic Hunt – Ranged attack with disruption targeting enemy with most prepared abilities.  This eliminates aim if different target  (Huntsman)
Huntsman.Major 11: Momentum Shot – Ranged attack that deals increased damage based on timer.  Sets timer to 0. (Huntsman)
Huntsman.Major 12: Penetrating Momentum – Ranged attack requiring momentum with penetration (Huntsman)
Huntsman.Major 13: Ravaging Shot – Ranged attack that lowers defense of target (Huntsman)
Huntsman.Major 14: Razing Bane – Ranged attack that targets a single enemy. Costs mana.  Attacks all enemies that share that type (Huntsman)
Huntsman.Move 1: Armor Bane – Lower defense of target enemy and all enemies of the same type.  Consumes aim (Huntsman)
Huntsman.Move 2: Distant Hunt – Enhance damage of next attack based on number of enemies in back row.  Must target enemy in back row (Huntsman)
Huntsman.Move 3: Hunting Party – Enhances party accuracy based on aim, consumes aim (Huntsman)
Huntsman.Move 4: Momentum Pull – Enhance damage and critical damage of next attack based on momentum (Huntsman)
Huntsman.Move 5: Speed Bane – Targets a single enemy.  Allies quicken whenever they attack an enemy of that type (Huntsman)
Huntsman.Move 6: Spiked Screen – Creates a cover that provides untyped retaliation until next turn (Huntsman)
Huntsman.Minor 1: Death Aim – Generates aim.  Follows enemy death (Huntsman)

Huntsman.Minor 3: Momentum Aim – Generates aim based on momentum (Huntsman)

Huntsman.Minor 5: Undergrowth Bane – Targets a single enemy.  Delays all enemies that share that type (Huntsman)

Crossbowman.Name: Crossbowman
Crossbowman.Quote: “It’s a simple enough device to use even you should be able to handle it.”
Crossbowman.Description: A heavy crossbow specialist who attacks more slowly than other archers but deals more damage per shot with greater penetration. He is more defensive than most archer subclasses, reacting to enemy attacks against him rather than purely pressing offense, and can fortify and reload quickly between shots.
Crossbowman.Mechanic: Rapid Reload — Crossbow attacks apply a reload delay to the Crossbowman after firing. Reload pushes the Crossbowman back on the action clock by an amount equal to the reload value multiplied by his speed — the faster he is, the more punishing the reload penalty. Rapid Reload abilities eliminate the reload from the next attack or the upcoming reload entirely, allowing the Crossbowman to negate this penalty at the cost of a minor or move action.
Crossbowman.Weapon Mech: very high damage, very long reload
Crossbowman.Major 1: Close Fire – Ranged attack with pointblank (Crossbowman)
Crossbowman.Major 2: Delaying Repetition – Multiple ranged attacks with delay consuming all aim (Crossbowman)
Crossbowman.Major 3: Hard Shot – Ranged attack with stun and disrupt (Crossbowman)
Crossbowman.Major 4: Hard Vow – Prepared ranged attack that chooses target on preparation.  Delays target on preparation and stuns on use (Crossbowman)
Crossbowman.Major 5: High Strung Shot – Ranged attack that deals extra damage based on weapon reload (Crossbowman)
Crossbowman.Major 6: Pointblank Shot – Ranged attack with pointblank and penetrate (Crossbowman)
Crossbowman.Major 7: Puncture Shot – Ranged attack with penetrating that lowers target defense (Crossbowman)
Crossbowman.Major 8: Push Through Bolt – Ranged attack with pointblank that can proc an attack against a column (Crossbowman)
Crossbowman.Major 9: Reloading Sequence – Two ranged attacks against single, eliminates reload (Crossbowman)
Crossbowman.Major 11: Taunting Shot – Ranged attack that taunts all enemies.  Delays self (Crossbowman)
Crossbowman.Major 12: Triple Reload – Three ranged attacks against single enemy with reload (Crossbowman)

Crossbowman.Move 2: Dodging Reload – Enhance dodge until next turn and eliminate next reload (Crossbowman)
Crossbowman.Move 3: Fortifying Caution – Grant ally fortification and consume aim (Crossbowman)

Crossbowman.Move 5: Obvious Preference – Compel target of aim and generate aim (Crossbowman)
Crossbowman.Move 6: Reactive Reload – Next time Crossbowman would be damaged while reloading, ignore hit and instantly reload (Crossbowman)
Crossbowman.Move 7: Skewering Shot Preparation – Next attack that criticals also attacks the enemy behind (Crossbowman)
Crossbowman.Minor 1: Attentive Reload – Eliminates next reload, generates aim (Crossbowman)
Crossbowman.Minor 2: Fortified Aim – Gain aim if fortified (Crossbowman)
Crossbowman.Minor 3: Heavy Delay – Next ranged attack that delays enemy has greater effect (Crossbowman)
Crossbowman.Minor 4: Nearing Accuracy – Enhance accuracy whenever attacked before next turn (Crossbowman)
Crossbowman.Minor 5: Prepared Reload – Eliminates next reload, quicken self (Crossbowman)
Crossbowman.Minor 6: Taunting Reload – Eliminate reload of next attack and taunt all enemies (Crossbowman)
Crossbowman.Capstone Skill: Instant Reload – The Crossbowman has a chance to reload after any ranged attack.

Marksman.Name: Marksman
Marksman.Description: An accuracy and penetration specialist who places marks on enemies that grant his allies benefits when they attack the same targets. He is the team's force multiplier at range, making his aim target more dangerous for everyone and sharing his exceptional accuracy with those who follow his lead.
Marksman.Mechanic: Marks — Marks are ongoing conditions placed on enemies. Only one mark can be active on any enemy at a time. While a mark is active, allies that attack the marked enemy receive a benefit specific to the mark type. Marks require and consume aim to place, and their duration and effects scale with aim invested.
Marksman.Major 1: Accuracy Snipe – Ranged attack that causes accuracy weakness on critical  (Marksman)
Marksman.Major 2: Aimed Assistance – Ranged attack consuming aim.  Causes Marksman to attack target whenever an ally attacks the target, consuming aim.  Ends when Marksman does not have enough aim to make this attack (Marksman)
Marksman.Major 3: Distant Aversion – Ranged attack against back row that causes aversion.  Prepared (Marksman)
Marksman.Major 4: Find the Hole – Ranged attack with penetration (Marksman)
Marksman.Major 5: Glancing Aim – Ranged attack that deals additional damage on glancing based on aim (Marksman)
Marksman.Major 6: Insinuating Shot – Ranged attack that causes next attack to be a guaranteed critical if it deals glancing damage (Marksman)
Marksman.Major 7: Marked Concord – Ranged attack that grants effect of mark for all allies.  Requires aim (Marksman)
Marksman.Major 8: Marked Shot – Ranged attack against enemy with mark.  Deals extra damage and generates extra effect from mark (Marksman)
Marksman.Major 9: Marking Vow – Prepared ranged attack that selects target on preparation.  Lowers dodge of target for a period on preparation (Marksman)
Marksman.Major 10: Reaping Aim – Ranged attack that deals reaping damage based on aim on target (Marksman)
Marksman.Major 11: Thunder Shot – Ranged air attack that stuns target (Marksman)
Marksman.Major 12: Unerring Distance – Ranged attack with distant and unerring (Marksman)

Marksman.Move 2: Accurate Follow Up – Ranged attack consuming aim following miss.  Gains bonus to accuracy based on miss amount (Marksman)
Marksman.Move 3: Clarity of Sight – Enhances all ally accuracy for their next attack (Marksman)
Marksman.Move 4: Concord Screen – Marksman shares quicken with all allies until next turn and generates aim, must be used as last action (Marksman)
Marksman.Move 5: Lightning Mark – Allies that attack the mark deal additional air damage and cause a storm attack against one enemy.  Consumes aim and follows hit (Marksman)
Marksman.Move 6: Marked with Blood – Marksman makes a ranged attack against aim target next time an ally criticals.  Prepared (Marksman)
Marksman.Move 7: Precision Follow Up – Prepared ranged attack consuming aim that follows hit.  Uses same attack roll of previous attack (Marksman)

Marksman.Minor 2: Critical Mark – The marked enemy takes more damage from criticals.  Consumes aim and follows a hit (Marksman)
Marksman.Minor 3: Heel Splinter – Follow damaging enemy by lowering its dodge until its next turn (Marksman)
Marksman.Minor 4: Invigorating Mark – “Strike there.  Don’t falter.” – Allies that attack the marked restore health.  Consumes aim and follows a hit (Marksman)
Marksman.Minor 5: Mana Mark – “Strike there.  Keep it up.”– Allies that attack the marked restore mana.  Consumes aim and follows a hit (Marksman)
Marksman.Minor 6: Quickening Mark – “Strike there.  Quicker.  Quicker.” -  Allies that attack the marked are quickened.  Consumes aim and follows a hit (Marksman)
Marksman.Capstone Skill: Unerring Marks – After the Marksman attacks a target, all attacks against the target are unerring for a number of times.

Falconer.Name: Falconer
Falconer.Description: A companion-focused archer whose pet falcon harries targets and enables abilities that either work better in the falcon's presence or require it outright. He uses the falcon to set up aim, distract enemies, and coordinate strikes — making his companion an active offensive asset rather than a passive attendant.
Falconer.Mechanic: Falcon — The Falconer's companion is a flying falcon that attacks the Falconer's aim target by default each turn. Many Falconer abilities function without a falcon present but receive bonuses or additional effects when one is active. Some abilities require the falcon companion specifically.
Falconer.Major 1: Eagle Eye Shot – Ranged attack with distant, pinpoint, and unerring.  Consumes aim (Falconer)
Falconer.Major 2: Eyestrike Swoop – Ranged attack that attacks alongside falcon, causing blind and delay (Falconer)
Falconer.Major 3: Falcon Bait – Ranged attack against a single target alongside attack from falcon (Falconer)

Falconer.Major 5: Falcon Claw – Falcon attacks aim target with damage enhanced by aim, causes untyped bleed (Falconer)
Falconer.Major 6: Harmonious Shot – Prepared unerring ranged attack with unerring attack from companion (Falconer)
Falconer.Major 7: Immediate Shot – Prepared ranged attack that has to be used the turn after it is prepared (Falconer)
Falconer.Major 8: Ongoing Accuracy – Ranged attack requiring aim that enhances Falconer’s accuracy based on pinpoint (Falconer)
Falconer.Major 9: Phantom Hawk – Afflict target with untyped bleed and distract.  Requires aim (Falconer)

Falconer.Major 11: Reaping End – Ranged attack against endangered enemy that deals reaping damage based on aim (Falconer)
Falconer.Major 12: Typhoon Shot – Ranged attack that consumes aim to cause prone (Falconer)

Falconer.Minor 5: Flanking Falcon – Afflict target with flanking.  Requires companion (Falconer)
Falconer.Minor 6: Fly High – Grants companion increased dodge until its next turn (Falconer)
Falconer.Capstone Skill: Flying Falcon – Falcon can only be targeted by ranged attacks and has increased dodge.

Bounty Hunter.Name: Bounty Hunter
Bounty Hunter.Quote: “There’s a bounty for your head.  Not sure about the rest of your body.”
Bounty Hunter.Description: A capture-specialist who places bounty afflictions on enemies as minor actions during combat, with those bounties triggering beneficial effects when the marked enemy dies. He can stun and incapacitate targets to take them alive, gaining increasing payoffs the more bounties he has active when enemies fall.
Bounty Hunter.Mechanic: Bounties — Bounty abilities are placed on an enemy as a minor action and must be used as the final action of the Bounty Hunter's turn. They have no immediate effect. When the targeted enemy dies, the bounty triggers and benefits the Bounty Hunter. Each bounty type grants a different reward on death.

Bounty Hunter.Major 2: Blunted Arrows – Minimized ranged attack with clobbering and disrupt (Bounty Hunter)

Bounty Hunter.Minor 7: Speed Claim – Spot incapacitated enemy to quicken self (Bounty Hunter)

Stalker.Name: Stalker
Stalker.Description: A shadow-fighter who generates aim from hidden status and converts high accuracy into higher damage, with a defining ability that expends all accumulated aim for a devastating single attack — but then prevents him from targeting that specific enemy for a period scaled to the aim spent.
Stalker.Weapon Mech: accuracy bonus scaling with target's lost health

Poacher.Name: Poacher
Poacher.Description: A kill-opportunist who triggers immediate prepared attacks the moment an enemy becomes endangered, without those poach abilities being interruptible by damage. He gains culling abilities, preferences for specific target types, and benefits from kills — a specialist at finishing weakened prey faster than anyone else can reach them.
Poacher.Mechanic: Poach Abilities — Poach abilities are prepared using aim. Once prepared, they cannot be disrupted. When any enemy becomes endangered, the prepared poach fires automatically against that enemy and becomes unprepared. Each use targets whichever enemy next hits the endangered threshold. To use a poach against a different enemy than the last, the Poacher must re-prepare it with a fresh aim cost.

Sharpshooter.Name: Sharpshooter
Sharpshooter.Description: A trick-shot specialist whose accuracy-dependent abilities pierce through targets to hit columns behind them and have reduced hit chance but significant effects when they connect. His trick shot success rate scales with current aim relative to maximum aim, rewarding sustained focus on a single target before committing to the high-risk high-reward shots.
Sharpshooter.Mechanic: Trick Shots — Trick shot abilities have a fixed low accuracy that cannot be improved by any means. Aim does not affect the hit chance. Instead, aim as a percentage of maximum aim determines whether the trick shot's special effect triggers if the attack hits. At higher aim percentages the effect is more likely to trigger; at lower aim it rarely does. Each trick shot has a distinct effect that only fires when the trickshot condition is met.

Sharpshooter.Major 7: Focal Shot – Ranged attack that generated focus based on pinpoint amount (Sharpshooter)
Sharpshooter.Major 8: Magebane Trickshot – Ranged attack that disrupts and disenchants if trickshot occurs (Sharpshooter)
Sharpshooter.Major 9: Penetration Echo Arrow – Ranged attack with countdown, both with penetration (Sharpshooter)

Sharpshooter.Move 2: Dedicated Accuracy – Remove avert and enhance accuracy (Sharpshooter)

Sharpshooter.Minor 1: Absolute Luck – Consume lucky to grant next attack unerring, unblockable, and unparryable (Sharpshooter)
Sharpshooter.Minor 2: Accuracy Test – Make an accuracy roll versus target and gain a bonus to next attack and critical damage based on success (Sharpshooter)
Sharpshooter.Minor 3: Dedicated Aim – Disenchant aim target of any compel or avert effect (Sharpshooter)
Sharpshooter.Minor 4: Dissuading Critical – Grants scorn following a critical (Sharpshooter)
Sharpshooter.Minor 5: Focus on Aim – Grants focus.  Requires aim (Sharpshooter)
Sharpshooter.Minor 6: Overkill Aim – Follows overkill with generating aim on new target based on overkill (Sharpshooter)
Sharpshooter.Minor 7: Responsive Speed – Sharpshooter quickens each time he is missed before next turn (Sharpshooter)

Toxophilite.Name: Toxophilite
Toxophilite.Description: A distance-and-duration specialist who builds power over the course of a long battle through eternal buff abilities that grow without limit but become progressively more expensive to enhance. Only one can be active at a time, demanding that the player commit to a single compounding effect and protect the Toxophilite long enough for it to pay off.
Toxophilite.Mechanic: Eternal Buffs — Eternal buffs are ongoing self-enchantments that stack upward without a limit. Only one eternal buff can be active at a time — activating a new one removes the previous. Each use increases the buff's power and also increases the cost of the next enhancement: they consume increasing amounts of aim or mana with each stack. There is no cap on how high they can go, but the escalating cost creates a practical limit within a wave.
Toxophilite.Major 1: Ambush Rain – Ranged attack against all enemies at full health, requires preparation. (Toxophilite)
Toxophilite.Major 2: Disintegrating Arrow – Ranged earth attack that deals corruption with massive damage (Toxophilite)
Toxophilite.Major 3: Distant Doom – Distant ranged attack with reduced accuracy but increased critical chance and critical damage (Toxophilite)
Toxophilite.Major 4: Essential Beginning – Ranged attack against full health requiring aim, deals 20% heartstrike (Toxophilite)
Toxophilite.Major 5: Eternal Destruction – Ranged attack that grants stacking critical damage enhancement, consuming increasing aim (Toxophilite)
Toxophilite.Major 6: Eternal Electrocution – Ranged attack with stacking air add, consuming increasing mana (Toxophilite)
Toxophilite.Major 7: Eternal Explosion – Ranged attack with stacking area damage, causing Toxophilite increasing delay (Toxophilite)
Toxophilite.Major 8: Eternal Marker – Ranged attack with pinpoint consuming aim, grants stacking accuracy enhancement (Toxophilite)
Toxophilite.Major 9: Eternal Truth – Ranged attack requiring aim with increased critical Chance.  On critical, it increases critical damage until the end of battle (Toxophilite)
Toxophilite.Major 10: Improbable Aim – Ranged attack with pinpoint proc based on current aim (Toxophilite)
Toxophilite.Major 11: Keen Slay – Ranged attack with increased culling range that consumes aim (Toxophilite)
Toxophilite.Major 12: Lightning Vow – Prepared ranged attack that selects target on preparation.  Deals random lightning damage to two other targets when used (Toxophilite)
Toxophilite.Major 13: Tailwind Shot – Distant attack and delay all others (Toxophilite)
Toxophilite.Move 1: Eternal Regeneration –Stacking regeneration that consumes increasing life (Toxophilite)
Toxophilite.Move 2: Eternal Sanctity – Purges afflictions, heals, and stacking affliction resistance, requires afflicted and costs increasing mana (Toxophilite)
Toxophilite.Move 3: Heavy Quiver – Number of next attacks based on aim delay enemies (Toxophilite)
Toxophilite.Move 4: Jagged Quiver – Number of next attacks based on aim have increased critical damage (Toxophilite)
Toxophilite.Move 5: Lightning Quiver – Number of next attacks based on aim deal extra air damage (Toxophilite)
Toxophilite.Move 6: Storm Screen – Prevents the Toxophilite from being affected by storm abilities until end of his next turn and generates aim.  Omega (Toxophilite)
Toxophilite.Minor 1: Aiming Observation – Alpha & Omega; generate aim on target for each attack made before next turn (Toxophilite)
Toxophilite.Minor 2: Distant Aim – Generates aim based on the number of back row enemies (Toxophilite)
Toxophilite.Minor 3: Distant Delay – Delays all enemies in back row (Toxophilite)
Toxophilite.Minor 4: Distant Distraction – Lowers the accuracy of all enemies in back row (Toxophilite)
Toxophilite.Minor 5: Eternal Dodge – Grants Toxophilite stacking dodge enhancement, while also causing stacking defense weakness (Toxophilite)
Toxophilite.Minor 6: Refill Quiver – Restore quiver abilities to a number based on current aim (Toxophilite)

Initiate.Name: Initiate
Initiate.Quote: “This is what all my training has led to.”
Initiate.Description: A patient striker who builds power by holding his form and releases it explosively on transition. His unleash mechanic rewards stillness — the longer he stays in a single form, the more devastating the eventual change. He has no form preference, making him the most flexible of the monk subclasses and a strong foundation for learning the chakra system.
Initiate.Weapon Mech: dodge bonus after attacking, duration scales with attack speed
Initiate.Capstone Skill: Tempered Resolve — Whenever the Initiate resists a percentage damage or death effect, his next attack gains increased damage.

Pugilist.Name: Pugilist
Pugilist.Description: A relentless single-target brawler who punishes the same enemy turn after turn through his impact mechanic. Any enemy he struck last turn becomes the target of a suite of specialized follow-up attacks covering damage, delay, disruption, and control. Lower chakra focused and strength-enhanced, he hits harder the longer he stays locked onto one target.
Pugilist.Weapon Mech: increased damage when attacking same enemy as previous turn
Pugilist.Capstone Skill: Impact Power – The Pugilist deals increased damage if he struck the same target the turn before.

Skirmisher.Name: Skirmisher
Skirmisher.Description: A fast, opportunistic fighter who mirrors his enemies' own strengths against them through the matching mechanic. He can temporarily adopt a target's critical stats, damage, accuracy, defense, or dodge — turning powerful enemies into their own worst nightmare. Leopard form focused and haste-driven, he excels at demolishing stunned foes and stacking bleeds through repeated Leopard Claw cycles.
Skirmisher.Weapon Mech: gains percentage of target's base damage on attack
Skirmisher.Capstone Skill: Stunning Roars — Any enemy that is stunned at the beginning of the Skirmisher's turn has their stun duration extended based on level.

Vajra.Name: Vajra
Vajra.Description: An immovable reactive combatant who weaponizes his chakra configuration to punish every enemy attack. Snake's Response reflects conditions back at attackers based on which chakras are open, with the lower chakras delivering the most devastating punishments — prone, delay, and disarm simultaneously at full configuration. He fights best when pristine, baiting attacks while armed with Reversal, Absorbed Counter, and a full suite of prepared reactions.
Vajra.Weapon Mech: chance to stun on reaction and counter attacks
Vajra.Capstone Skill: Diamond Body — If the Vajra does not target an enemy during his turn, he has a chance to ignore all damage until his next turn.

Stonefist.Name: Stonefist
Stonefist.Description: A fortified earth specialist who turns glancing blows from a weakness into a weapon. His attacks deliberately seek glancing hits to trigger stuns, bleeds, delays, and fragility — and his Pressure Crack capstone extends this to critical hits as well. Tiger form focused and endurance-heavy, he is nearly immovable under sustained assault and punishes enemies for every attempt to pierce his defenses.
Stonefist.Capstone Skill: Pressure Crack — When the Stone Fist scores a critical hit, it also triggers any glancing hit effects on that attack.

Infiltrator.Name: Infiltrator
Infiltrator.Quote: “Get in.  Get the job done.  Get out.  Don’t get spotted.”
Infiltrator.Description: A burst-damage specialist who cycles through hidden states to deliver devastating arrival attacks. Each time he loses hidden — whether by choice or enemy action — he unleashes a different arrival ability covering area damage, flanking, stunning, or penetrating strikes. Mantis focused and initiative-driven, his Exposed Momentum capstone ensures every exposure accelerates his next turn.
Infiltrator.Weapon Mech: enhanced critical chance immediately after losing hidden status
Infiltrator.Capstone Skill: Exposed Momentum — Whenever the Infiltrator loses hidden, he is quickened.

Viper Fang.Name: Viper Fang
Viper Fang.Description: A poison-crafting snake form specialist who generates unique toxins from his own body and bleeds. He creates poisons based on his current form through Venom Chakra, conserves and refreshes them through careful resource management, and delivers them through venomous, insidious, and backbiting strikes. Earth and dark elemental focused, he excels at sustained damage over time and attrition warfare.
Viper Fang.Weapon Mech: poison applies even on glancing hits
Viper Fang.Capstone Skill: Poisonous Refreshment – Whenever the associated proc triggers, the Viper Fang gains a poison use.

Ascetic.Name: Ascetic
Ascetic.Description: A disciplined dragon form purist who draws power from maintaining a state of perfect purity. His most powerful abilities — Fist of Purity, Double Purity, Whirlwind Purity — require being completely unafflicted, while his Condition Fortress capstone makes him progressively harder to afflict as conditions accumulate. He manages corruption, stuns enemies with dragon-powered strikes, and uses focus as both a resource and a defensive tool.
Ascetic.Capstone Skill: Condition Fortress — The Ascetic gains increased affliction resistance for each condition currently affecting him, whether affliction or enchantment.

Thunderfist.Name: Thunderfist
Thunderfist.Quote: “I strike like lightning, and thunder follows.”
Thunderfist.Description: A chain-combat specialist who builds devastating sequences of air, stun, and shatter effects through careful ability ordering. Nearly every move and minor ability has a trigger condition — following a counter, a critical, a shatter, or an air attack — creating dense combo potential that rewards mechanical knowledge. Crane focused and counter-driven, his Thunder Strikes capstone ensures every stunned enemy takes bonus air damage on each hit.
Thunderfist.Weapon Mech: delayed secondary damage add after initial attack
Thunderfist.Capstone Skill: Thunder Strikes — Whenever the Thunderfist attacks a stunned enemy, that enemy also takes air damage.

Drunken Master.Name: Drunken Master
Drunken Master.Quote: “One more drink and I’ll get to it.”
Drunken Master.Description: A chaotic form-shifting brawler who embraces randomness and prone states as sources of power rather than liability. He shifts forms rapidly to build Fluid Punch damage, reach Ultimate Punch thresholds, and trigger Chakra Ascension — while deliberately falling prone to counter from the ground and punish enemies with Misplaced Retribution. His unpredictability is his greatest defense, with low accuracy offset by high dodge and a tendency to accidentally hit exactly the wrong person at exactly the right time.
Drunken Master.Weapon Mech: dodge bonus on miss, scales with miss amount
Drunken Master.Capstone Skill: Counter from the Ground – The Drunken Master can counter even if prone or disarmed.  Higher levels increase chance to counter.

Bandit.Name: Bandit
Bandit.Description: A quick ranged harasser who opens battle at a distance before pivoting to a more dangerous close-quarters fighter when his allies fall. He carries desperation abilities that only activate when he stands alone, rewarding survival over coordinated play.
Bandit.Major 1: All Down to Me – Powerful ranged attack against single that requires alone and consumes combat advantage (Bandit)
Bandit.Major 2: All Out Advantage, Major – Powerful melee attack that consumes all advantage up to 6 (Multiplier:  Advantage^2*9%)  (Bandit)
Bandit.Major 3: Desperation Drain – Melee attack against single target with life drain.  Advantage cost reduced if alone (Bandit)
Bandit.Major 4: Desperation Onslaught – Multiple random ranged attacks consuming all advantage.  The advantage cost per attack is reduced to half if alone (Bandit)
Bandit.Major 5: Desperation Ripper – Melee attack against single target with powerful bleed.  Advantage cost reduced if alone (Bandit)
Bandit.Major 6: Desperation Shot – Ranged attack with pinpoint that consumes advantage.  Consumes less advantage if Bandit is alone (Bandit)
Bandit.Major 7: Desperation Trap – Ranged trap with bleed.  Greatly delays bandit unless he is endangered (Bandit)
Bandit.Major 8: Final Poison Shot – Ranged attack that uses all poisons.  Requires endangered (Bandit)
Bandit.Major 9: Last Blood – Culling melee attack requiring Bandit is alone (Bandit)
Bandit.Major 10: Mana Crash – Ranged attack that also deals mana damage.  If target ends with zero mana, generates combat advantage (Bandit)
Bandit.Major 11: Ranged Backstab – Ranged attack against flanked enemy with pinpoint (Bandit)
Bandit.Major 12: Sniper Shot 3 – Ranged attack that consumes all advantage for extra damage, up to 6 combat advantage.  Gains critical chance based on combat advantage (Bandit)
Bandit.Move 1: Delaying Poison – Provides Rogue with a poison that delays target (Bandit)
Bandit.Move 2: Desperation Mana – Drains mana from all enemies and grants it to bandit.  Advantage cost reduced if alone (Bandit)
Bandit.Move 3: Endangering Advantage – Spot an endangered enemy to gain advantage (Bandit)
Bandit.Move 4: Nothing Left at All – Prepared ability that grants intangible.  Requires alone (Bandit)
Bandit.Move 5: Spirotoxin – Grants the target an air damage poison to their attacks (Bandit)
Bandit.Move 6: Sunlens Toxin – Provides Bandit with poison that causes light exposure (Bandit)
Bandit.Minor 1: Accuracy Advantage – Consumes some advantage to gain accuracy to next attack based on advantage (Bandit)
Bandit.Minor 2: Advantageous Loneliness – Generates one advantage, requires alone (Bandit)
Bandit.Minor 3: Desperation Hide – Gain hidden, requires being alone (Bandit)
Bandit.Minor 4: Desperate Foolishness — Minor, alone required, disrupts and damages mana (Bandit)
Bandit.Minor 5: Desperate Evasion — alone required, increases dodge vs next attack (Bandit)
Bandit.Minor 6: Seize on Critical – Enhance dodge following critical (Bandit)
Bandit.Minor 7: Seize on Dodge – Enhance critical chance following dodge. (Bandit)
Bandit.Capstone Skill: Extended Ambush – Ambush abilities can be used while target has over a percentage of life.

Cutthroat.Name: Cutthroat
Cutthroat.Description: A dualwield melee brawler who stacks bleed on enemies through relentless two-weapon exchanges and can grant himself intangibility to press the offense without interruption. His advantage generation rewards staying in the fight and bleeding targets dry.
Cutthroat.Major 1: All Out Bleeding – Melee attack that consumes all advantage and causes increased bleeding based on advantage used (Cutthroat)
Cutthroat.Major 2: Backstab Rend – Dualwield melee attack that requires flanking.  Deals extra damage if both attacks hit (Cutthroat)
Cutthroat.Major 3: Bloodseeker Slash – Melee attack against bleeding target (Cutthroat)
Cutthroat.Major 4: Bloody Evisceration – Melee attack against enemy with stacking bleed that deals additional damage based on bleed (Cutthroat)
Cutthroat.Major 5: Critical Evisceration – Melee attack that causes bleed on critical (Cutthroat)
Cutthroat.Major 6: Discrete Dagger – Ranged attack with insidious that causes untyped bleed (Cutthroat)
Cutthroat.Major 7: Distracting Duo – Two melee attacks against a target.  First attack causes flanked.  Consumes advantage (Cutthroat)
Cutthroat.Major 8: First Needle – Melee attack that starts stacking bleed, but does not stack itself.  Consumes advantage (Cutthroat)
Cutthroat.Major 9: Ghost Strike – Melee attack with heartstrike that requires intangible (Cutthroat)
Cutthroat.Major 10: Intangible Advantage – Ranged attack requiring intangible.  Generates advantages and disenchants intangible at end of attack (Cutthroat)
Cutthroat.Major 11: Precise Cut – Melee attack with enhanced accuracy that causes untyped bleed on critical.  Requires preparation (Cutthroat)
Cutthroat.Major 12: Thousand Needles – Storm ranged attack that afflicts targets with individual stacks of stacking bleed.  Consumes advantage (Cutthroat)
Cutthroat.Major 13: Toxic Blood Slash – Melee attack with venomous that further enhances bleeding poisons (Cutthroat)
Cutthroat.Move 1: Blood in the Eyes – Blind enemy suffering from bleed (Cutthroat)
Cutthroat.Move 2: Blood Thinner – Grants Cutthroat poison that applies stacking bleed to target (Cutthroat)
Cutthroat.Move 3: Bloodlet – Melee attack following a bleed (Cutthroat)
Cutthroat.Move 4: Critical Hematoma – Follow a critical hit with afflicting target with untyped bleed (Cutthroat)
Cutthroat.Move 5: Etherealness — costs mana, grants any hero intangible (Cutthroat)
Cutthroat.Move 6: Pneumotoxin – Poison that adds water bleeds to attacks (Cutthroat)
Cutthroat.Minor 1: Anatomic Knowledge – Increase damage of next bleed effect (Cutthroat)
Cutthroat.Minor 2: Bloody Missteps – Flank all bleeding enemies.  Omega (Cutthroat)
Cutthroat.Minor 3: Extended Bleed – Refreshes bleeds on the target (Cutthroat)
Cutthroat.Minor 4: Poisonous Advantage – Consume advantage to enhance potency of poison (Cutthroat)
Cutthroat.Minor 5: Revel in Bloodshed – Spot at least one bleeding enemy for a chance to gain advantage.  The more bleeding enemies, the more advantage that can be gained. (Cutthroat)
Cutthroat.Minor 6: Shift into Position – Flank target following a miss (Cutthroat)
Cutthroat.Capstone Skill: Stacking Bleed Proc – The modified skill has a chance to afflict the target with a stacking bleed.

Burglar.Name: Burglar
Burglar.Description: An ambush specialist who hits hardest against undamaged enemies and strips buffs from those who have fought back. He can artificially recreate full-health windows late in battle by corrupting enemy maximum health, keeping his ambush toolkit relevant throughout.
Burglar.Weapon Mech: extra damage against full health enemies
Burglar.Capstone Skill: Trap Disarmament – Whenever the Burglar would otherwise trigger a trap on the field, they have a chance to remove that trap completely.

Thief.Name: Thief
Thief.Description: A self-sufficient dualwield fighter who steals accuracy, speed, and senses from enemies to empower himself. He can briefly share his incoming healing and mana gain with allies, giving a team-oriented edge to an otherwise personal playstyle.
Thief.Capstone Skill: Grand Larceny — Steal abilities have a chance to trigger a free attack (uses tag system)

Acrobat.Name: Acrobat
Acrobat.Description: A dodge-focused rebuild Rogue who invites attacks, turns misses into advantage, and uses reliable abilities that refund their costs on failure. He thrives in the open and under illumination, unlike most Rogues who prefer the shadows.
Acrobat.Weapon Mech: increased accuracy to next attack after missing, scales with miss amount
Acrobat.Capstone Skill: Glancing Dodge – Whenever the Acrobat suffers a glancing hit, it has a chance to be considered a dodge based on this skill.

Assassin.Name: Assassin
Assassin.Description: A single-target executioner who signs contracts against chosen enemies, gaining combat bonuses while pursuing them and earning powerful fulfillment rewards when he personally lands the killing blow. Five contract types let the player tailor each hunt to the situation.
Assassin.Weapon Mech: chance for instant death to overwhelm resistance
Assassin.Capstone Skill: Transfer Contract — Next attack after a contract ends applies that contract to the new target

Brigand.Name: Brigand
Brigand.Description: A ranged gambler who wagers advantage and mana on battlefield conditions, collecting larger payoffs when those conditions are met. A good run leaves him flush; a bad one leaves him empty, making risk tolerance the central skill of his playstyle.
Brigand.Weapon Mech: critical damage increases on failed critical
Brigand.Capstone Skill: Double Down — Enemies have a chance not to lose flanked at the start of their turn

Smuggler.Name: Smuggler
Smuggler.Description: A team-oriented Rogue whose power scales with how many allies are hidden alongside him. He can blanket the party in shadow, share his poisons across the team, and coordinate hidden allies into a unified striking force.
Smuggler.Capstone Skill: Smuggled Poisons - The first poison gained by the smuggler is also shared with all allies.  The amount of uses is based on this skill.

Skulk.Name: Skulk
Skulk.Description: A defensively self-reliant Rogue who applies aversion to make enemies ignore him, then punishes them for it. He complements aversion with scorn to layer targeting protection, generating advantage steadily from the safety of being overlooked.
Skulk.Capstone Skill: Aversion Backstab – Whenever an enemy averted by the skulk attacks, the skulk attacks it in response.

Ninja.Name: Ninja
Ninja.Description: A hidden-mastery specialist who chains haste, advantage, and free bonus attacks by maintaining concealment across multiple actions. He rewards players who have mastered the hidden economy, with insidious attacks and precise sequencing separating competent play from exceptional play.
Ninja.Capstone Skill: Second Poison — The Ninja can apply a second poison simultaneously

Scavenger.Name: Scavenger
Scavenger.Description: A chaotic support-attacker who thrives on unpredictability. Her scavenged abilities reveal their element on preparation rather than use, making her toolkit flexible but harder to plan around. She generates ammo from kills and builds belts from whatever she has on hand — a scrappy, resource-efficient subclass that rewards improvisation.
Scavenger.Weapon Mech: damage and ammo load based on mana, mana ammo

Alchemist.Name: Alchemist
Alchemist.Description: A prepared-resource specialist who enters battle with concoctions already brewed and ready to use without cost or preparation. She leans into healing, poison, and resurrection, and her premade system lets her open waves with full-power abilities immediately. Her capstone Premade Reserves deepens this advantage, making her the Teknixian most oriented toward sustained party management.
Alchemist.Capstone Skill: Premade Reserves – Premade abilities have a chance to have multiple uses at the beginning of battle.

Artificer.Name: Artificer
Artificer.Description: A trap-setter and accumulator who builds up power before releasing it. Her accumulation abilities charge on first use and discharge on second, rewarding patience with amplified outputs. She also controls the detonation chain — recovering, redirecting, and shielding through it — and provides elemental shields to allies via Teknos Shielding.

Tinker.Name: Tinker
Tinker.Description: A modification-based companion commander who toggles different behavioral modes to reshape her companion and her own attacks. Her four modular abilities — Modular Bomb, Modular Ray, Modular Trap, and Modular Beam — each change behavior based on which modifications are active. Flame Spewer and Lightning Tosser are ammo-sensitive companions that change element and effect based on what's loaded at summoning.
Tinker.Capstone Skill: True Chaos – Chaos abilities both use a random elemental power and target a random elemental resistance.

Engineer.Name: Engineer
Engineer.Description: An ally-empowerment specialist who assigns persistent assistant enchantments to party members. Each assistant type triggers a different proc when the assigned ally attacks — shields, heals, traps, bonus attacks, or quickening — and Activate Assistant can fire all procs simultaneously. She also fields the Shield Guardian, a fixed-behavior healing companion with no ammo interaction, and Minefield Assistant turns any attacker into a trap-seeding machine.

Bomber.Name: Bomber
Bomber.Description: A high-risk area damage dealer whose bomb abilities hit allies and enemies identically with no discount. She layers countdowns on enemies and manages the self-threat they create using Accept Explosion, Accept Mass Explosion, Gift Bomb, and Transfer Countdown. Explosion Imminent and Kinetic Protection let her mitigate her own friendly fire. The higher the aim output, the harder the landing.
Bomber.Weapon Mech: fires random amount of ammo per shot, flechette ammo

Gunslinger.Name: Gunslinger
Gunslinger.Description: A pure ranged damage dealer built around called shots and burst ammo expenditure. Called shots are prepared as a minor action, name a target, and add powerful debuff effects — disarm, stun, heartstrike, slow, or delay — to the first attack used against that target on the following turn. Full Clip and Oblivion Shot are her all-in damage options. High Noon and Showdown both guarantee a counter-attack against her, rewarding Take Cover setups.
Gunslinger.Weapon Mech: dual ranged, light damage add, light ammo
Gunslinger.Capstone Skill: Quick Call – Called shots can be activated the same turn they are used.

Savant.Name: Savant
Savant.Description: A slow-burn debuff-accumulator whose six concoctions apply ongoing effects while building power each clock tick, then discharge a scaled effect when the chain fires or time runs out. More ammo at placement extends the window and increases accumulated power at detonation. A Faraday sub-theme lets her wear lightning rod deliberately and redirect incoming storm damage offensively through Faraday Connection's pain link.
Savant.Weapon Mech: mana gain on attack, water ammo

Machinist.Name: Machinist
Machinist.Description: A companion-amplifier who fields extremely slow, powerful siege engine companions — Ballista, Battering Ram, and Catapult — and spends her own actions making them fire more frequently. Every move and minor ability in her kit serves the companion: Operate Siege Engine quickens it directly, Teamwork Operation converts party delay into companion clock advancement, and Siege Command upgrades whatever the companion would do next. Her own attacks like Amplifying Cannonshot and Earth Cannon give her meaningful damage when she steps away from the engine.
Machinist.Weapon Mech: chance for area damage, fire ammo

Reliquarian.Name: Reliquarian
Reliquarian.Description: A relic-stacking power escalator who activates multi-ability relics that grow stronger with each ammo devotion. Each devoted ammo type is locked until the relic ends — which it cannot be cancelled until max devotion — creating deep commitment costs in exchange for battlefield-wide buffs, persistent damage, companion power, or trap generation. Relic Blast and Relic Bolt scale with total ammo devoted across all active relics, making a fully stacked Reliquarian increasingly devastating the longer a wave goes on.

Brute.Name: Brute
Brute.Description: The patient tank of the Barbarian family. A slower, higher-endurance variant who defers self-damage costs to the next turn through Consequences, generating Anguish immediately while controlling when the pain lands — or redirecting it to enemies entirely with Share Consequence.
Brute.Major 1: Breathtaking Blow – Melee attack that consumes rage to deal clobbering damage and exhaust foe. (Brute)
Brute.Major 2: Brutal Consequences – High damage melee attack and generate rage, but take damage at beginning of next turn (Brute)
Brute.Major 3: Dangerous Ruse – Melee attack with reduced accuracy that causes damage to self on a miss (Brute)
Brute.Major 4: Deliberate Clobber – Melee attack with increased accuracy, critical chance, and clobbering.  Requires rage and delays user (Brute)
Brute.Major 5: Internal Bleeding Blow – Melee attack that causes untyped bleeding with clobber (Brute)
Brute.Major 6: Mammoth Consequences – Melee attack against all enemies and generate rage, but take damage at beginning of next turn (Brute)
Brute.Major 7: Opening Blow – Melee attack against enemy with full health (Brute)
Brute.Major 8: Ruthless Cascade – Melee attack that cascades if it deals ruthless damage.  This effect can repeat multiple times, but each enemy can only be targeted once (Brute)
Brute.Major 9: Stunning Consequences – Melee attack with stun and generate rage, but take damage at beginning of next turn (Brute)
Brute.Major 10: Tiring Delay – Melee attack that further delays target based on their tired value (Brute)
Brute.Major 11: Unbalancing Attack – Melee attack that lowers Brute’s dodge until next turn (Brute)
Brute.Major 12: Unguarded Advance – Melee attack that lowers unit’s defense until next turn (Brute)
Brute.Move 1: Benefit from Consequences – Enhance defense based on damage taken at beginning of turn (Brute)
Brute.Move 2: Great Stomp – Delay all enemies.  If any enemy would go below 0 timer, knock it prone (Brute)
Brute.Move 3: Guardian Consequences – Taunt all enemies, gain damage shield, and generate rage, but take damage and lose damage shield at beginning of next turn (Brute)
Brute.Move 4: Purging Consequences – Purge affliction from Brute and generate rage, but take damage at beginning of next turn (Brute)
Brute.Move 5: Stomp – Melee attack against prone enemy (Brute)
Brute.Move 6: Unbroken Flesh – Brute gains fortification; requires full health (Brute)
Brute.Minor 1: Greater Consequences – Increase effect of consequence ability and take more damage from it at beginning of next turn (Brute)
Brute.Minor 2: Green Warpaint – Grants immunity to wound and enhanced earth resistance (Brute)
Brute.Minor 3: Share Consequences – The first target the Brute attacks takes the same damage she did from consequences (Brute)
Brute.Minor 4: Solid Sarcophagy – Brutes damages himself and enhances defense (Brute)
Brute.Minor 5: Speed Consequences – Quicken self and generate rage, but take damage at beginning of next turn (Brute)
Brute.Minor 6: Stoic Rage – Consume rage to ignore criticals until next turn (Brute)
Brute.Minor 7: Stubborn Rage – The Barbarian deals extra damage with glancing blows and takes reduced damage from glancing blows while in this rage.  When this rage ends, the Barbarian becomes blind. (Brute)
Brute.Capstone Skill: Ignore Consequences – Whenever the brute would suffer consequences at the beginning of her turn due to a consequences ability, she has a chance to ignore those consequences.

Raider.Name: Raider
Raider.Description: A shield-and-weapon fighter who builds active defenses only to spend them all at once. Reckless abilities consume all block, dodge, and counter values for amplified attacks, rewarding players who time the exposed window around a supporting tank or use it as a finisher when consequences can't resolve.
Raider.Weapon Mech: damage on block or enhanced retaliation
Raider.Major 1: Charging Ambush – Melee attack against column.  Front target must have full health (Raider)
Raider.Major 2: Fury Tremor – Melee attack against all requiring raging that consumes all rage to enhance damage and knock enemies prone  (Raider)
Raider.Major 3: Glancing Blood – Melee attack that causes bleed on glancing hit based on glancing damage dealt (Raider)
Raider.Major 4: Glancing Stun – Melee attack that causes stun on glancing hit based on glancing damage dealt (Raider)
Raider.Major 5: Gravity Cleave – Melee attack that prevents active defenses until next turn, with decimate based on active defenses lost (Raider)
Raider.Major 6: Lingering Fury – Melee attack and enhance next damage by rage (Raider)
Raider.Major 7: Looming Threat – Melee attack against compelled target.  Switches target of compel (Raider)
Raider.Major 8: Precipitous Cleave – Melee attack with sudden; quickens raider if she is raging (Raider)
Raider.Major 9: Raid Preparation – Melee attack with low accuracy that enhances damage and dodge on miss (Raider)
Raider.Major 10: Reckless Clobber – Clobbering melee damage.  Prevents Raider from using active defenses and counters until next turn (Raider)
Raider.Major 11: Reckless Flames – Fire damage versus all enemies.  Prevents Raider from using active defenses and counters until next turn (Raider)
Raider.Major 12: Reckless Rampage – Three melee attacks against random enemies.  Prevents Raider from using active defenses and counters until next turn (Raider)
Raider.Major 13: Reckless Reaper – Melee attack with ruthless against single enemy.  Prevents Raider from using active defenses and counters until next turn (Raider)
Raider.Move 1: Glancing Guarantee – Melee attack that deals only glancing damage (Raider)
Raider.Move 2: Rage Shield – Consume rage to guarantee block against next attack.  Also stuns attacker (Raider)
Raider.Move 3: Reckless Haste – Gain haste based on block chance and amount.  Prevents active defenses and counters for same duration (Raider)
Raider.Move 4: Reckless Impact – Delay all enemies.  Prevents Raider from using active defenses and counters until next turn (Raider)
Raider.Move 5: Shield Clobber – Melee attack using shield with clobber (Raider)
Raider.Move 6: Shield Recklessness – Melee attack following block.  Prevents all active defenses until next turn (Raider)
Raider.Minor 1: Blue Warpaint – “I’m already dead.  I will not yield.” – Grants immunity to slow and enhanced water resistance (Raider)
Raider.Minor 2: Reckless Recovery - Prepared ability. If the Raider takes a critical hit while Reckless, remove the Reckless status. (Raider)
Raider.Minor 3: Reckless Speed – Quickens Raider.  Prevents Raider from using active defenses and counters until next turn (Raider)
Raider.Minor 4: Shield Counters – Instead of blocking, makes counters based on shield.  Toggled ability (Raider)
Raider.Minor 5: Take the Hit – Prevent all active defenses until next turn to raise defense based on active defenses (Raider)
Raider.Minor 6: Vengeance Rage – The Barbarian gains increased counter chance and damage while in this rage.  When this rage ends, the Barbarian becomes unable to make counters and has reduced dodge. (Raider)
Raider.Capstone Skill: Reckless Attack – Attacks from the Raider have a chance to deal increased damage at the cost of preventing any active defenses until next turn.

Berserker.Name: Berserker
Berserker.Description: The chaos amplifier of the family, built around Exertion abilities that generate Anguish from repeated misses and spread destruction through Contagious Temper. She leans fully into the Berserk condition, turning random targeting from a liability into an engine, with the Panic pair offering a rare moment of choice between embracing or escaping the disorder.
Berserker.Major 1: Backbiting Exertion – Melee attack with lower accuracy and backbiting.  If attack misses, take damage and reattempt once (Berserker)
Berserker.Major 2: Berserk Exertion – Melee attack with lower accuracy that attacks randomly and requires berserk.  If attack misses, take damage and reattempt once (Berserker)
Berserker.Major 3: Berserk Ignorance – Melee attack and purge any conditions that occurred since last turn.  Requires berserk (Berserker)
Berserker.Major 4: Berserk Strike – Melee attack that causes berserk to user.  Can be used while berserk, but becomes random in that case and extends berserk (Berserker)
Berserker.Major 5: Bleeding Exertion – Melee attack with lower accuracy that causes bleeds and quicken self.  If attack misses, take damage and reattempt once (Berserker)
Berserker.Major 6: Bloodlust Quicken – Melee attack that quickens Berserker based on bloodlust (Berserker)
Berserker.Major 7: Brutal Exertion – Melee attack with lower accuracy that lowers defense.  If attack misses, take damage and reattempt once (Berserker)
Berserker.Major 8: Callous Blow – Melee attack that grants barrier to self and can only be used berserk (Berserker)
Berserker.Major 9: Feckless Blow – Melee attack that causes flanking on berserker (Berserker)
Berserker.Major 10: Great Cleave – Melee attack versus single that damages enemies in same row as target against combined defense of primary and secondary target (Berserker)
Berserker.Major 11: Raging Exertion – Melee attack based enhanced by rage.  If this attack misses, take damage and repeat. (Berserker)
Berserker.Move 1: Berserk Jab – Melee attack that requires berserk (Berserker)
Berserker.Move 2: Berserk Patience – Counter next attack.  Requires berserk (Berserker)
Berserker.Move 3: Berserker Strength – Enhance damage for a period.  Requires berserk (Berserker)
Berserker.Move 4: Contagious Temper – Berserks all allies and enhances damage for their next attack.  Requires berserk, can be used berserk (Berserker)
Berserker.Move 5: Extra Exertion – Take damage and repeat exertion ability that missed twice. (Berserker)
Berserker.Move 6: Vicious Rampage – Enhance damage and speed for a period.  Become fatigued when buff is lost (Berserker)
Berserker.Minor 1: Angry Vengeance – Enhance damage each time berserker is attacked before next turn (Berserker)
Berserker.Minor 2: Berserk Rage – The Barbarian gains untyped retaliation while in this rage.  When this rage ends, the Barbarian becomes flanked. (Berserker)
Berserker.Minor 3: Combat Surge – Melee attack.  Requires berserk.  Follows missing with an attack (Berserker)
Berserker.Minor 4: Enraging Counter – Counter next attack.  Requires endangered.  Gain berserk after counter (Berserker)
Berserker.Minor 5: Growing Fury – Gain rage.  Requires berserk (Berserker)
Berserker.Minor 6: Orange Warpaint – Grants immunity to stun and enhanced air resistance (Berserker)
Berserker.Minor 7: Panic Clarity – Purge berserk and enhance defense until next turn.  Requires berserk and endangered (Berserker)
Berserker.Minor 8: Panic Might – Gain berserk and enhance damage of next attack.  Requires endangered and not berserk.  Consumes rage. (Berserker)
Berserker.Capstone Skill: Double Exertion – Exertion effects trigger twice.

Marauder.Name: Marauder
Marauder.Description: A dual-wield closer who grows faster and hits harder the more enemies die. Rampage scales with kills — personal kills more than team kills — making bloodlust and counter abilities the tools that keep her offense rolling between turns and feeding the escalation she depends on.
Marauder.Weapon Mech: rampage bonus scaling with enemy deaths
Marauder.Major 1: Berserk Rampage – Melee attack requiring berserk that deals additional damage based on each enemy killed in battle (Marauder)
Marauder.Major 2: Bloodlust Rampage – Melee attack that has increased bloodlust value for each enemy killed in battle (Marauder)
Marauder.Major 3: Clobbering Rampage – Melee attack that has increased clobbering value for each enemy killed in battle (Marauder)
Marauder.Major 4: Clobbering Rend – Two melee attacks against a single target.  Uses clobbering if both attacks hit (Marauder)
Marauder.Major 5: Critical Assault – Melee attack that attacks all on critical.  Consumes rage (Marauder)
Marauder.Major 6: Double Attack – Two melee attacks that add together before comparison to defense (Marauder)
Marauder.Major 7: Dual Rampage – Melee attack requiring dual wielding that deals additional damage for each enemy killed in battle (Marauder)
Marauder.Major 8: Eviscerating Rend – Two melee attacks against a single target.  Causes heartstrike if both attacks hit (Marauder)
Marauder.Major 9: Off-hand Preparations – Dual wield melee attack that compels target and enhances counter chance (Marauder)
Marauder.Major 10: Onslaught Rampage – Dual-wield melee attack that makes an additional attack on a random enemy for each enemy killed in battle (Marauder)
Marauder.Major 11: Vicious Tumult – Melee attack with bloodlust with increased accuracy and critical chance based on bloodlust, consumes rage (Marauder)
Marauder.Major 12: Wave of Bloodlust – Melee attack against all with bloodlust (Marauder)
Marauder.Move 1: Counter Rampage – Guarantee counter against next attack.  Requires enough enemies killed in battle, and enhanced for total enemies killed in battle (Marauder)
Marauder.Move 2: Deadly Persistence – Follows a kill with a melee attack (Marauder)
Marauder.Move 3: Doubled Counter – Next counter attacks with both weapons.  Requires dual-wielding (Marauder)
Marauder.Move 4: Rage Counter – Counter next attack with damage enhanced by rage.  Requires and consumes rage (Marauder)
Marauder.Move 5: Rampage Haste – Grants Marauder haste based on the number of enemies killed in battle (Marauder)
Marauder.Move 6: Rampage Hostility – Enhances damage based on number of enemies killed.  Consumes rage (Marauder)
Marauder.Move 7: Rampage Speed – Quickens Marauder based on number of enemies killed in battle (Marauder)
Marauder.Minor 1: Berserk Response – Enhance counter chance until next turn.  Requires berserk (Marauder)
Marauder.Minor 2: Marauder’s Rage – The Barbarian gains increased critical chance and critical damage while in this rage.  When this rage ends, the Barbarian becomes fragile. (Marauder)
Marauder.Minor 3: Off-hand Counter – Guaranteed counter with off-hand weapon against next melee attack  (Marauder)
Marauder.Minor 4: Rampage Raid – Gain rage based on number of enemies killed in battle (Marauder)
Marauder.Minor 5: Red Warpaint – “You can’t see my blood.  I will not bleed.” – Grants to immunity to bleeds and enhanced fire resistance (Marauder)
Marauder.Minor 6: Roar of Triumph – Follows killing an enemy.  Reduces defenses of all enemies for a period (Marauder)
Marauder.Capstone Skill: Initial Rampage – The Marauder begins battle with a value of rampage based on this skill.

Viking.Name: Viking
Viking.Description: A deliberate shield fighter who charges prepared abilities through sustained blocking. Each block adds power to any held ability, and multiple prepared abilities charge independently, rewarding patient setup and precise release timing over the Raider's impulsive spending.
Viking.Major 1: Bloodlust Response – Melee attack with bloodlust following a block (Viking)
Viking.Major 2: Continuous Turmoil – Attack, then attack all on critical (Viking)
Viking.Major 3: Furious Tumult – Melee attack with bloodlust that consumes rage (Viking)
Viking.Major 4: Razor Shield – Prepared melee attack with high untyped bleed. Enhanced by blocks made since preparation. (Viking)
Viking.Major 5: Shield Decimation – Prepared melee attack with decimate. Enhanced by blocks made since preparation. (Viking)
Viking.Major 6: Shield Smash — Prepared melee attack. Damage and clobbering value enhanced by blocks made since preparation. (Viking)
Viking.Major 7: Shield Throw – Prepared melee attack against all enemies. Enhanced by blocks made since preparation. (Viking)
Viking.Major 8: Shield Wall – Prepared melee attack against enemy row. Enhanced by blocks made since preparation. (Viking)
Viking.Major 9: Steel Suffering – Melee attack that causes untyped bleed and defense weakness (Viking)
Viking.Major 10: Taunting Axe – Melee attack with damage increased by rage that taunts enemies (Viking)
Viking.Major 11: Taunting Shield – Melee attack that enhances block chance and taunts enemies (Viking)
Viking.Major 12: Undertow Blow – Prepared unblockable water melee attack that delays and causes water bleed (Viking)
Viking.Major 13: Violent Push – Melee attack that causes prone to enemies behind target (Viking)
Viking.Move 2: Savage Shield – Melee attack with shield following block.  Consumes rage (Viking)
Viking.Move 3: Shield Sacrifice – Enhance block chance until next turn.  Costs life. (Viking)
Viking.Move 4: Shield of Superstition – Enhance magic resistance and lower block chance until next turn (Viking)
Viking.Move 5: Shield to Shield – Prepared ability that triggers on block.  Prevent target enemy from blocking for a period (Viking)
Viking.Move 6: Splash Shield – Prepared ability that deals water damage to front row on next block (Viking)
Viking.Minor 1: Berserk Block – Guaranteed block versus next attack.  Requires berserk (Viking)
Viking.Minor 2: Block and Respond – Quickens unit on block until next turn (Viking)
Viking.Minor 3: Brown Warpaint – Grants immunity to compel and avert and resistance versus delays (Viking)
Viking.Minor 4: Heavy Shield – Add clobber to next melee attack but lower block chance until next turn (Viking)
Viking.Minor 5: Shield Fighting – Enhances damage and weakens block chance while active (Viking)
Viking.Minor 6: Shield Rage – The Barbarian gains increased block chance and amount while in this rage.  When this rage ends, the Barbarian loses all active defenses. (Viking)

Vandal.Name: Vandal
Vandal.Description: Pure escalating output. She accumulates damage dealt toward a threshold that briefly unlocks Brink abilities — powerful options that vanish if not taken — and can sustain Endless Wrath longer than any other subclass before the drain finally overtakes her.
Vandal.Major 1: Awesome Cleave – Melee attack versus single that damages all other enemies against combined defense of primary and secondary target (Vandal)
Vandal.Major 2: Brink of Death – Melee attack with ruthless damage. Only becomes available for one turn immediately after dealing enough damage (Vandal)
Vandal.Major 3: Brink of Inferno – Fire melee attack that grants fire damage add. Only becomes available for one turn immediately after dealing enough damage (Vandal)
Vandal.Major 4: Brink of Onslaught – Three randomly targeting melee attacks. Only becomes available for one turn immediately after dealing enough damage (Vandal)
Vandal.Major 5: Brink of Violence – Melee attack with backbiting. Only becomes available for one turn immediately after dealing enough damage (Vandal)
Vandal.Major 6: Endless Beating – Prepared melee attack.  This attack stays prepared if you are raging (Vandal)
Vandal.Major 7: Escalating Violence – Melee attack with amplification that is always countered (Vandal)
Vandal.Major 8: Ferocious Spree – Melee attack with amplification that consumes increasing amounts of rage (Vandal)
Vandal.Major 9: Intimidating Charge – Melee attack with momentum that causes frightened, requires rage (Vandal)
Vandal.Major 10: Raging Cleave – Large weapon attack that strikes target enhanced by rage and adjacent enemies based on rage (Vandal)
Vandal.Major 11: Ruthless Strike – Ruthless melee attack requiring rage (Vandal)
Vandal.Major 12: Ultimate Violence – Melee attack consuming rage that deals maximum damage (Vandal)
Vandal.Move 1: Angry Ignorance – Chance to ignore attacks based on rage (Vandal)
Vandal.Move 2: Brink of Purity – Purge Vandal of afflictions.  Only becomes available for one turn immediately after dealing enough damage. (Vandal)
Vandal.Move 3: Brink of Reprisal – Taunt all enemies and guaranteed counter versus next melee attack.  Only becomes available for one turn immediately after dealing enough damage (Vandal)
Vandal.Move 4: Callous Words – Taunts enemies to attack Vandal and prevents Vandal from taking glancing damage until next turn.  Generates rage and can be used berserk (Vandal)
Vandal.Move 5: Extended Offense – Melee attack with backbite and causes flanked to user (Vandal)
Vandal.Move 6: Rage Gamble – Enhance maximum damage until end of turn based on rage (Vandal)
Vandal.Minor 1: Brink of Eternity – Grants Vandal enduring. Only becomes available for one turn immediately after dealing enough damage (Vandal)
Vandal.Minor 2: Brink of Speed – Quicken Vandal.  Only becomes available for one turn immediately after dealing enough damage (Vandal)
Vandal.Minor 3: Endless Rage – The Barbarian gains more rage from abilities and effects, while abilities that consume rage have greater effect while in the rage.  When this rage ends, the Barbarian becomes unable to gain rage. (Vandal)
Vandal.Minor 4: Exacerbate Rage – Vandal gains more rage from damage until next turn (Vandal)
Vandal.Minor 5: Fiery Rage – Vandal gains fire damage add to next attack this turn.  Requires berserk (Vandal)
Vandal.Minor 6: Mystic Sarcophagy – Vandal deals damage to himself and enhances elemental resistance (Vandal)
Vandal.Minor 7: Yellow Warpaint – Grants immunity to blind and enhanced light resistance (Vandal)
Vandal.Capstone Skill: Close to the Edge – Attacks the Rager make generate more threshold towards her Brink abilities

Fury.Name: Fury
Fury.Description: Precise and fast, with a discipline that belies her name. Purity abilities amplify with each use but cancel on specific failure conditions, demanding focused play to maintain multiple stacks simultaneously. She grows faster as she takes damage and reaches peak power when Wrath and Berserk combine.
Fury.Major 1: Amplified Savagery – Melee attack with backbiting and amplification, can be used berserk (Fury)
Fury.Major 2: Blood Purity – Melee attack with increasing bleed, resets if barbarian attacks the target suffering from this bleed. (Fury)
Fury.Major 3: Critical Purity – Melee attack with increased critical chance and critical damage, but with reduced accuracy, resets if the barbarian misses. (Fury)
Fury.Major 4: Endless Exchange – Melee attack that causes tired for self and target.  Tired duration increased for target and decreased for herself based on rage (Fury)
Fury.Major 5: Expeditious Strike – Melee attack that quickens the fury and that requires haste.  Can be used while berserk (Fury)
Fury.Major 6: Furious Drive – Melee attack that enhances speed on critical, stacking.  Increased critical chance based on rage and can be used berserk (Fury)
Fury.Major 7: Killing Amplification – Melee attack that provides amplification with any other ability on kill (Fury)
Fury.Major 8: Quickening Purity – Melee attack with increasing quicken effect, but it reduces defense and dodge.  This can be disrupted. (Fury)
Fury.Major 9: Ranged Purity – Ranged attack with increasing damage, but this resets if the barbarian attacks a close enemy. (Fury)
Fury.Major 10: Sacrifice Purity – Melee attack with increasing damage and backbiting, but this ends if the barbarian is healed. (Fury)
Fury.Major 11: Staggering Fury – Melee storm with delay on each hit (Fury)
Fury.Major 12: Storm Purity – Melee attack.  Each use makes an additional random attack, each with backbite, but this ends if the same enemy is hit twice in a turn. (Fury)
Fury.Move 1: Absorb Death – Gain enduring until next turn.  If enduring triggers, gain extra rage (Fury)
Fury.Move 2: Exploding Speed – Gain haste after critical.  Amplified (Fury)
Fury.Move 3: Exploding Strength – Gain damage enhancement after critical.  Amplified (Fury)
Fury.Move 4: Furious Control – Taunt one enemy for each attack suffered since last turn (Fury)
Fury.Move 5: Hasted Jab – Melee attack that requires haste (Fury)
Fury.Move 6: Imperiled Speed – Quickens and enhances speed of endangered unit (Fury)
Fury.Move 7: Rage Jab – Melee attack that consumes rage (Fury)
Fury.Minor 1: Adrenaline – Quicken self and enhance damage, only usable endangered (Fury)
Fury.Minor 2: Black Warpaint – Grants immunity to illuminate and enhanced dodge (Fury)
Fury.Minor 3: Dedicated Speed – Quicken next turn but are compelled against same target (Fury)
Fury.Minor 4: Speed Rage – The Barbarian gains haste and increased speed while in this rage.  When this rage ends, the Barbarian is slowed. (Fury)
Fury.Minor 5: Speed through Pain – Deals damage to self to quicken (Fury)
Fury.Minor 6: Suffer for Savagery – Take damage to increase critical chance until end of turn (Fury)
Fury.Capstone Skill: Bloody Berserk – Attack the Rager makes while berserk also have backbiting based on the level of this skill.

Cannibal.Name: Cannibal
Cannibal.Description: A self-sustaining predator who stays hurt to stay fed. Her healing threshold mechanic unlocks powerful abilities as applicable healing accumulates, rewarding healers who time large heals over constant top-offs, while life drain and kill-reaction heals give her independence when the support is occupied elsewhere.
Cannibal.Weapon Mech: damages self at start of turn for stat bonus
Cannibal.Major 1: Bloodlust Bite – Melee attack with bloodlust requiring rage (Cannibal)
Cannibal.Major 2: Devour the Sleeping – Culling melee attack against incapacitated target.  Heal on kill (Cannibal)
Cannibal.Major 3: Devour Whole – Cull target enemy to heal, gain mana, and gain all enchantments on target enemy (Cannibal)
Cannibal.Major 4: Gnashing Consumption – Melee attack that causes untyped bleed on target.  Requires the Cannibal to have received enough healing (Cannibal)
Cannibal.Major 5: Grave Hunger – Melee attack with drain requiring Cannibal to be endangered (Cannibal)
Cannibal.Major 6: Health Stealing Bite – Melee attack with drain that also applies heal siphon to target (Cannibal)
Cannibal.Major 7: Mana Consumption – Melee attack that drains mana from target.  Requires the Cannibal to have received enough healing (Cannibal)
Cannibal.Major 8: Maximum Satiation – Maximized melee attack requiring Cannibal has been healed enough (Cannibal)
Cannibal.Major 9: Rabid Bite – Melee attack with untyped bleed and wound (Cannibal)
Cannibal.Major 10: Sacrificial Consumption – Melee attack with backbiting.  Requires having been healed enough (Cannibal)
Cannibal.Major 11: Unsated Hunger – Prepared melee attack with life drain that becomes unprepared if Cannibal is healed (Cannibal)
Cannibal.Major 12: Vampiric Bite – Melee attack with drain requiring rage (Cannibal)
Cannibal.Move 1: Dark Devouring – Gain a dark damage add following a kill (Cannibal)
Cannibal.Move 2: Feast on Rage – Follows a critical with rage gain (Cannibal)
Cannibal.Move 3: Feast on the Remains – Follows a kill with a self heal (Cannibal)
Cannibal.Move 4: Sated Haste – Prepared ability that activates when Cannibal has been healed enough.  Grants haste (Cannibal)
Cannibal.Move 5: Sated Jab – Melee attack versus single enemy.  Requires the Cannibal to have received enough healing (Cannibal)
Cannibal.Move 6: Shield Consumption – Gain damage shield.  Requires the Cannibal to have received enough healing (Cannibal)
Cannibal.Minor 1: Hungry Rage – The Barbarian drains life with melee attacks while in this rage.  When this rage ends, the Barbarian becomes wounded. (Cannibal)
Cannibal.Minor 2: Rage Consumption – Generate rage.  Requires having been healed enough (Cannibal)
Cannibal.Minor 3: Sated Purge – Prepared ability that activates when Cannibal has been healed enough.  Purges afflictions (Cannibal)
Cannibal.Minor 4: Sickness Sarcophagy – Cannibal takes damage and enhances affliction resistance (Cannibal)
Cannibal.Minor 5: Spread Satiation – Heal all allies and take damage based on healing.  Requires Cannibal to have received enough healing. (Cannibal)
Cannibal.Minor 6: Urge to Feed – Quicken after draining life based on life drained (Cannibal)
Cannibal.Minor 7: Violet Warpaint – Grants immunity to vulnerability and enhanced dark resistance (Cannibal)
Cannibal.Capstone Skill: Vampiric Devotion – Life drain effects are not affected by vitality, but healing has a greater drain on vitality.

Destroyer.Name: Destroyer
Destroyer.Description: The armor-stripping heavyweight, built to cross the massive damage threshold and trigger cascading effects that tear down enemy defenses for the whole team. Destruction Wrath amplifies weakness power and defense reduction, but ends in forsaken and strips all enchantments — making dedicated buffers a liability rather than an asset.
Destroyer.Major 1: Approaching Victory – Melee attack that quickens all based on overkill (Destroyer)
Destroyer.Major 2: Cascading Critical – Melee attack that cascades to random target on critical (Destroyer)
Destroyer.Major 3: Critical Balance – Melee attack that cannot critical, but deals additional damage based on critical damage (Destroyer)
Destroyer.Major 4: Destroy Armor – Melee attack with shattering that causes fragile to the target (Destroyer)
Destroyer.Major 5: Entropy Hammer – Melee attack with clobbering that deals corrupt damage (Destroyer)
Destroyer.Major 6: Grudgebearer – Attack with defense weakness against enemy that attacked unit turn before (Destroyer)
Destroyer.Major 7: Massive Burst – Melee attack that damages all enemies if it deals massive damage (Destroyer)
Destroyer.Major 8: Massive Cascade – Melee attack that cascades if attack deals massive damage.  This effect can repeat multiple times, but each cascade must target a different enemy (Destroyer)
Destroyer.Major 9: Massive Corruption – Melee attack that converts damage to corrupt if it is massive damage (Destroyer)
Destroyer.Major 10: Massive Destruction – Melee attack that lowers all enemy defense if it deals massive damage (Destroyer)
Destroyer.Major 11: Massive Stupidity – Melee attack that disrupts and deals mana damage to all enemies if it deals massive damage (Destroyer)
Destroyer.Major 12: Massive Suffering – Massive damage melee attack with backbiting (Destroyer)
Destroyer.Major 13: Weapon Fracture – Melee attack with shattering that can disarm the target (Destroyer)
Destroyer.Move 1: Armor Destruction – Next melee attack reduces enemy defense based on damage (Destroyer)
Destroyer.Move 2: Chink in the Armor – Target’s defense and resistance versus next attack is halved. (Destroyer)
Destroyer.Move 3: Massive Barrier – Gain barrier and damage shield following massive damage (Destroyer)
Destroyer.Move 4: Massive Follow-Up – Melee attack following attack that dealt massive damage (Destroyer)
Destroyer.Move 5: Opening Fragility – Afflict target enemy at full health with fragile (Destroyer)
Destroyer.Move 6: Raging Brawn – Consume rage to enhance damage (Destroyer)
Destroyer.Minor 1: Destruction Rage – The Barbarian lowers enemy defense on attacks and has increased weakness power while in this rage.  When this rage ends, the Barbarian loses all enchantments and becomes forsaken. (Destroyer)
Destroyer.Minor 2: Greater Mass – Increase massive damage values until end of turn (Destroyer)
Destroyer.Minor 3: Grey Warpaint – “I paint my skin like stone and steel.” – Grants immunity to fragile and enhanced defense (Destroyer)
Destroyer.Minor 4: Massive Rage – Generate rage, follows massive damage (Destroyer)
Destroyer.Minor 5: Massive Strength – Enhance damage, follows massive damage and based off massive damage (Destroyer)
Destroyer.Minor 6: Massive Taunt – Provoke all enemies and gain damage shield following massive attack (Destroyer)
Destroyer.Capstone Skill: Massive Power – The threshold for triggering massive damage is lowered for the Destroyer.

Beastlord.Name: Beastlord
Beastlord.Description: The apex predator and most complex of the Barbarian subclasses. She cycles between four exclusive beast forms, scales overkill into team-wide debuffs, and generates Anguish from damage dealt to any ally — turning chaotic encounters into fuel. Final Wrath guarantees her death when it ends, making every use of it the last decision she makes.
Beastlord.Major 1: Animalistic Attack – Melee attack based on current animal form.  Consumes rage (Beastlord)
Beastlord.Major 2: Bull’s Rampage – Three random melee attack that cause bleed and requires rage (Beastlord)
Beastlord.Major 3: Call Rampaging Rhino – Summons a rampaging rhino mount with trample abilities (Beastlord)
Beastlord.Major 4: Feral Health Strike – Melee attack that heals user.  Heals extra if attack kills (Beastlord)
Beastlord.Major 5: Might Exacerbation – Melee attack that requires berserk, enhances damage but Beastlord becomes tired (Beastlord)
Beastlord.Major 6: Raging Charge – Mounted melee attack enhanced by rage (Beastlord)
Beastlord.Major 7: Rampant Umbrage – Melee attack that deals damage based on overkill of previous attack  (Beastlord)
Beastlord.Major 8: Rending Force – Melee attack that lowers defense of all enemies by overkill (Beastlord)
Beastlord.Major 9: Riven Force – Melee attack that lowers damage of all enemies based on overkill (Beastlord)
Beastlord.Major 10: Trample Underfoot – Mounted melee attack versus column.  Each enemy counters the beastlord, but the beastlord generates extra rage for the damage.  On a critical, enemies are knocked prone (Beastlord)
