Beastlord.Major 11: Ultimate Rage Strike – Consume all remaining rage and end rage form immediately to make massive attack (Beastlord)
Beastlord.Move 1: Bestial Strength – Gain an ongoing buff and upgrade next attack based on current beast form (Beastlord)
Beastlord.Move 2: Feral Ignorance – Ignore criticals until next turn.  Requires berserk (Beastlord)
Beastlord.Move 3: Feral Wrath – Increase critical chance and damage of next attack.  Requires berserk (Beastlord)
Beastlord.Move 4: Mounted Overkill – Quicken mount and enhance its damage based on overkill of previous attack (Beastlord)
Beastlord.Move 5: Rage Exacerbation – Extends current rage, but Beastlord becomes tired (Beastlord)
Beastlord.Move 6: Raging Umbrage – Follows overkill by generating rage and quickening Beastlord (Beastlord)
Beastlord.Minor 1: Final Defender – Gain rage and enhance defense.  Requires being alone (Beastlord)
Beastlord.Minor 2: Final Rage – The Barbarian gains massive damage bonuses and enduring while in this rage.  When this rage ends, the Barbarian dies. (Beastlord)
Beastlord.Minor 3: Form of the Bull – The Beastlord gain ongoing enhanced defense.  The Beastlord also gains fortify on critical hits.  Consumes rage. (Beastlord)
Beastlord.Minor 4: Form of the Eagle – The Beastlord gain ongoing enhanced dodge.  The Beastlord can also make attacks and counters at range.  Consumes rage. (Beastlord)
Beastlord.Minor 5: Form of the Panther – The Beastlord gain ongoing enhanced speed.  The Beastlord also gains hidden at the beginning of her turns.  Consumes rage. (Beastlord)
Beastlord.Minor 6: Form of the Wolf – The Beastlord gain ongoing enhanced damage.  The Beastlord also has a chance to cause prone when attacking flanked targets.  Consumes rage. (Beastlord)
Beastlord.Minor 7: Golden Warpaint – Grants immunity to weakness and enhanced healing received (Beastlord)
Beastlord.Minor 8: Rage Observation – Beastlord generates rage from damage dealt to any ally. (Beastlord)
Beastlord.Capstone Skill: Reactive Beast Form – The Beastlord has a chance to gain a beast form whenever damaged.

Gladiator.Name: Gladiator
Gladiator.Description: A flashy, risk-taking fighter who uses gambit abilities that either succeed spectacularly or backfire against her. Critical Stance generates expertise on critical hits, and her gambits deal high damage or critical effects at a cost — such as becoming prone on a miss or inviting counter attacks — rewarding aggressive play with chain weapons.
Gladiator.Major 1: All-in Strike – Melee attack with high damage, high critical damage, and low accuracy.  Gladiator becomes prone on miss (Gladiator)
Gladiator.Major 2: Deflection Gambit – High damage, low accuracy melee attack that randomly attacks another target, enemy or ally, on miss.  Requires expertise (Gladiator)
Gladiator.Major 3: Disarming Gambit – Melee attack with disarm, but gladiator becomes disarmed if this fails (Gladiator)
Gladiator.Major 4: Exciting Exchange – Melee attack that cannot be parried but is always countered (Gladiator)
Gladiator.Major 5: Onslaught Gambit – Melee attack against each enemy with reduced accuracy, but enemies counter gladiator on each miss (Gladiator)
Gladiator.Major 6: Precise Strike, Greater – Melee attack with increased accuracy and critical chance, but delays gladiator (Gladiator)
Gladiator.Major 7: Risky Positioning – Melee attack with blessed accuracy and damage, but causes the gladiator to be flanked (Gladiator)
Gladiator.Major 8: Shattering Sequence – Two shattering melee attacks against a single target consuming expertise (Gladiator)
Gladiator.Major 9: Stunning Gambit – Melee attack that stuns target.  Higher chance to be countered and gladiator becomes stunned if countered (Gladiator)
Gladiator.Major 10: Unremitting Slash – Attack that stays prepared if it misses, lower accuracy (Gladiator)
Gladiator.Major 11: Wild Hope – Melee attack with low accuracy that heals self on hit and damages self on miss (Gladiator)
Gladiator.Major 12: Wound Striker – Melee attack against target wounded enemy (Gladiator)
Gladiator.Move 1: Claim Glory – Prepared reaction to any enemy using a compel or provoke ability.  Melee attack against enemy (Gladiator)
Gladiator.Move 2: Counter Gambit – Guaranteed counter against next attack, but next attack is a critical hit versus the Gladiator (Gladiator)
Gladiator.Move 3: Face the Coward – Purges all allies and field of aversion and scorn effects. (Gladiator)
Gladiator.Move 4: Fist Stratagem – Spend expertise when next attacked to guarantee counter (Gladiator)
Gladiator.Move 5: Parry Stun – Follows parrying since last turn.  Stuns target that was parried (Gladiator)
Gladiator.Move 6: Rip Armor – Lower defense of target stunned enemy (Gladiator)
Gladiator.Move 7: Sand in the Eyes – Blinds the target (Gladiator)
Gladiator.Minor 1: Critical Expertise – Generate expertise following a critical (Gladiator)
Gladiator.Minor 2: Critical Stance – Enhances critical chance, gladiator generates expertise when she criticals (Gladiator)
Gladiator.Minor 3: Intimidation Gambit – Either stuns all enemies or ends turn of gladiator, alpha (Gladiator)
Gladiator.Minor 4: Prepared Correction – Gladiator reattempts the next attack that misses.  Prepared and consumes expertise (Gladiator)
Gladiator.Minor 5: Reaping Gambit – Next attack deals reaping damage.  On miss, it also deals reaping damage to Gladiator (Gladiator)
Gladiator.Minor 6: Turn to Enemy – Purges Gladiator of aversion (Gladiator)
Gladiator.Capstone Skill: High Stakes – Whenever the Gladiator attacks, he has a chance to deal 150% damage or 75% damage, as determined by skill level.

Duelist.Name: Duelist
Duelist.Description: A one-handed sword specialist who excels at counter attacks and is almost impossible to disarm or knock down. Counter Stance generates expertise whenever she counters, and her kit is built around parries and ripostes — parrying an attack, then immediately punishing the attacker with a follow-up strike.
Duelist.Major 1: Careful Strike – Melee attack with increased accuracy and lower damage  (Duelist)
Duelist.Major 2: Critical Disarm – Melee attack that disarms on critical (Duelist)
Duelist.Major 3: Disarmed Disaster – Alpha.  High damage melee attack versus disarmed enemy (Duelist)
Duelist.Major 4: Disarming Killer – Melee attack with cull against disarmed target (Duelist)
Duelist.Major 5: Disarming Strike – Melee attack with a chance to disarm target (Duelist)
Duelist.Major 6: Duel Bond – Melee attack that grants enhanced damage against target if it attacks a different ally before next turn (Duelist)
Duelist.Major 7: Dueling Strike – Melee attack that compels target to attack duelist and compels duelist to attack target.  Quickens Duelist (Duelist)
Duelist.Major 8: End the Duel – Disarm target enemy, then attack it based on expertise.  Consumes all expertise (Duelist)
Duelist.Major 9: Expert Blow, Enhanced – Melee attack that requires expertise (Duelist)
Duelist.Major 10: Expert Penetration – Melee attack with penetration based off expertise (Duelist)
Duelist.Major 11: Inevitable Blade – Melee attack.  On miss, gain enhanced accuracy and damage with next melee attack.  Requires expertise (Duelist)
Duelist.Major 12: Off-Balance Disarm – Melee attack with a chance to disarm target enemy.  Requires flanked (Duelist)
Duelist.Major 13: Pinpoint Stab – Melee attack with bleed based off pinpoint.  Requires expertise to use (Duelist)
Duelist.Move 1: Disarming Counter – Duelist has a chance to disarm on counters until next turn (Duelist)
Duelist.Move 2: Disarming Dominance – Melee attack following disarm against the disarmed (Duelist)
Duelist.Move 3: Expert Retaliation – Grants untyped retaliation based off expertise (Duelist)
Duelist.Move 4: Instant Counter – On next counter, instead gain an immediate turn (Duelist)
Duelist.Move 5: Penetrating Counter – Counter next attack with penetration (Duelist)
Duelist.Move 6: Shield Disarm – Prevent disarmed enemy from blocking while it is disarmed (Duelist)
Duelist.Minor 1: Advance on Disarmed – Gain expertise if an enemy is disarmed (Duelist)
Duelist.Minor 2: Counter Stance – Enhances counter chance, duelist generates expertise when she counters (Duelist)
Duelist.Minor 3: Disarming Preparation – Increases chance to disarm, requires expertise (Duelist)
Duelist.Minor 4: Learn from my Mistake – Generate expertise if previous attack was countered (Duelist)
Duelist.Minor 5: Parry Clang – Next parry distracts parried enemy (Duelist)
Duelist.Minor 6: Solid Grip – Cannot be disarmed until next turn (Duelist)
Duelist.Capstone Skill: Disarming Follow Up – The Duelist makes an immediate attack against any enemy that gains the disarmed condition.

Phalanx.Name: Phalanx
Phalanx.Description: A heavy shield bearer who fights best alongside ready allies. Shield Stance generates expertise on every block, and her toolkit includes guaranteed blocks, fortification at the cost of tired, and Phalanx Power, which enhances the damage of all ready allies based on how many are still standing.
Phalanx.Weapon Mech: increased damage per ally ready to act
Phalanx.Major 1: Inevitable Strike – Melee attack that requires expertise that is unblockable, unerring, and unparryable (Phalanx)
Phalanx.Major 2: Overwhelming Strike – Melee attack with overwhelming.  Requires expertise (Phalanx)
Phalanx.Major 3: Phalanx Combo – Melee attack against single enemy with damage enhanced by ready allies (Phalanx)
Phalanx.Major 4: Phalanx Decimation – Melee attack with decimate enhanced by ready allies (Phalanx)
Phalanx.Major 5: Phalanx Onslaught – Number of melee attacks based on number of ready allies (Phalanx)
Phalanx.Major 6: Phalanx Overrun – Melee attack against row with damage enhanced by ready allies (Phalanx)
Phalanx.Major 7: Phalanx Unity – Melee attack that quickens and enhances block chance of all ready allies based on number of ready allies (Phalanx)
Phalanx.Major 8: Puncturing Piercer – Melee attack with penetrate that causes defense weakness on critical (Phalanx)
Phalanx.Major 9: Shield and Strike – Melee attack enhanced by shield following block (Phalanx)
Phalanx.Major 10: Shield Breaker – Melee attack that lowers target’s block chance (Phalanx)
Phalanx.Major 11: Shield Press – Melee attack with stun and disrupt following block (Phalanx)
Phalanx.Major 12: Shield Rush – Melee attack with chance to cause prone based on block chance (Phalanx)
Phalanx.Major 13: Spear and Shield – Melee attack with reduced accuracy and ranged 1 that enhances block chance (Phalanx)
Phalanx.Move 1: Defensive Exploit – Gains damage shield and increased counter chance based on expertise, consumes all expertise (Phalanx)
Phalanx.Move 2: Expert Blocking – Enhances block chance of the target.  This enhancement is increased by expertise if user is a fighter (Phalanx)
Phalanx.Move 3: Phalanx Guard – Grant damage shield to all ready allies enhanced by number of ready allies (Phalanx)
Phalanx.Move 4: Respond for Me – Next time phalanx takes a critical hit, she quickens and enhances damage of all allies  (Phalanx)
Phalanx.Move 5: Shield Stratagem – Spend expertise when next attacked to guarantee block (Phalanx)
Phalanx.Move 6: Turtle Command – All allies gain enhanced blocking until their next turn (Phalanx)
Phalanx.Minor 1: Exhaustive Defense – Gain fortified in return for becoming tired (Phalanx)
Phalanx.Minor 2: Healthy Block – Guaranteed block against next attack.  Requires full health and delays Phalanx (Phalanx)
Phalanx.Minor 3: Phalanx Power – Enhance damage of all ready allies until end of their turn based on the number of ready allies (Phalanx)
Phalanx.Minor 4: Prepare Phalanx – Set the timer of all ready allies to 1000 minus their speed.  Alpha, Omega. (Phalanx)
Phalanx.Minor 5: Shield Expertise – Follow a block with generating expertise (Phalanx)
Phalanx.Minor 6: Shield Stance – Increases block chance, gain expertise on blocking (Phalanx)
Phalanx.Capstone Skill: Hurry Phalanx – Whenever the Phalanx becomes ready, she quickens any ally within a short timer of action threshold to also become ready.

Dervish.Name: Dervish
Dervish.Description: A dual-wielding speed specialist whose defining abilities trigger on the second strike of a sequence, becoming more powerful the sooner that second hit follows the first. Speed Stance generates expertise from quicken effects, and she builds momentum and haste through attacks to fuel an escalating flurry of blows.
Dervish.Major 1: After Image Blow – Two attacks against one target, requires haste (Dervish)
Dervish.Major 2: Burst Succession – Dual-wield attack that damages all enemies with second attack based on dual-wield attack speed. (Dervish)
Dervish.Major 3: Critical Succession – Dual-wield attack with increased critical chance and critical damage for second attack based on dual-wield attack speed. (Dervish)
Dervish.Major 4: Double Rend – Dualwield melee attack that hits twice with each weapon.  If all attacks hit, deal extra damage (Dervish)
Dervish.Major 5: Dual Momentum – Dual wield attack with both attacks enhanced by momentum (Dervish)
Dervish.Major 6: Elusive Succession – Dual-wield attack that grants Dervish enhanced dodge after second attack based on dual-wield attack speed. (Dervish)
Dervish.Major 7: Expert Onslaught – Consumes all expertise to make random melee attacks based on the amount of expertise (Dervish)
Dervish.Major 8: Momentum Onslaught – Melee attack that strikes a number of times based on momentum, alpha (Dervish)
Dervish.Major 9: Quick Succession – Dual-wield attack that quickens the Dervish after second attack based on dual-wield attack speed. (Dervish)
Dervish.Major 10: Shearing Exploit – Damage all and lower defense based on expertise, consumes all expertise (Dervish)
Dervish.Major 11: Stunning Succession – Dual-wield attack that stuns target on second hit based on dual-wield attack speed. (Dervish)
Dervish.Major 12: Whirling Blades – Dual-wielding attack that quickens the dervish and damages enemies adjacent to the target (Dervish)
Dervish.Major 13: Zephyr Strike – Melee attack that quickens all on critical, critical modifier affects quicken (Dervish)
Dervish.Move 1: Aura of Blades – Grants Dervish retaliation which increases when quickened.  Requires expertise (Dervish)
Dervish.Move 2: Critical Momentum – Enhances critical chance based on momentum until end of turn (Dervish)
Dervish.Move 3: Expert Speed – Enhances speed of an ally, increased by expertise (Dervish)
Dervish.Move 4: Final Sprint – Sudden melee attack that consumes haste (Dervish)
Dervish.Move 6: Tangling Momentum – Delays target based on momentum (Dervish)
Dervish.Minor 1: Bounding Advance – Next melee attack can be used at range (Dervish)
Dervish.Minor 2: Double Accuracy – Enhance accuracy of next dual-wield attack (Dervish)
Dervish.Minor 3: Expert Sprint – Quicken self.  Consumes expertise (Dervish)
Dervish.Minor 4: Rapid Dualwield – Increases dual-wield speed until end of turn. (Dervish)
Dervish.Minor 5: Rended Speed – Quicken self following dual wield attack (Dervish)
Dervish.Minor 6: Speed Stance – Gains expertise whenever the fighter is affected by a quicken effect.  Increases the speed of the fighter (Dervish)
Dervish.Capstone Skill: Constant Momentum – If the Dervish begins her turn under a momentum threshold, she generates momentum but is delayed by a greater amount.

Fencer.Name: Fencer
Fencer.Description: An extraordinarily accurate fighter who specializes in pinpoint attacks that can activate additional conditions at high enough values. Pinpoint Stance generates expertise from hit rolls beyond what is needed to connect, and her kit rewards fighting alone — with Alone Damage and Alone Defense passives that keep her effective as the last fighter standing.
Fencer.Major 1: Accurate Focus – Melee attack that grants focus if pinpoint value is high enough (Fencer)
Fencer.Major 3: Critical Exploit – Damage with increased critical chance and damage based on expertise, enhances critical chance and damage, consumes all expertise (Fencer)
Fencer.Major 4: Exact Stroke – Melee attack with high accuracy and pinpoint (Fencer)
Fencer.Major 5: Expert Blow, Superior – Melee attack that requires 60 expertise (Fencer)
Fencer.Major 6: Final Fighter – Melee attack requiring alone that enhances counter chance and parry based on damage (Fencer)
Fencer.Major 7: Gap in the Armor – Melee attack with pinpoint accuracy (Fencer)
Fencer.Major 8: Penetrating Pinpoint – Melee attack with pinpoint, then penetrates based on pinpoint.  Prepared (Fencer)
Fencer.Major 9: Penetrating Thrust – Melee attack with penetration on critical (Fencer)
Fencer.Major 10: Pinpoint Parries – Melee attack with pinpoint that enhances parry based on pinpoint.  Requires expertise (Fencer)
Fencer.Major 11: Pinpoint Surge – Melee attack that delays all other enemies based on pinpoint value.  Requires expertise (Fencer)
Fencer.Major 12: Solo Strike – Melee attack with pinpoint requiring alone (Fencer)
Fencer.Move 1: Blade Flow – Enhance accuracy following parry (Fencer)
Fencer.Move 2: Blade Stratagem – Spend expertise when next attacked to guarantee parry (Fencer)
Fencer.Move 3: Expert Accuracy – Enhances accuracy of the target, increased by expertise (Fencer)
Fencer.Move 4: Flanking Response – Prepared reaction to become flanked.  Melee attack against flanker and ignore flanked (Fencer)
Fencer.Move 5: Focused Deflection – Consume focus when next attacked to guarantee parry (Fencer)
Fencer.Move 6: Pinpoint Retaliation – Gain untyped retaliation based on pinpoint value of last attack (Fencer)
Fencer.Move 7: Riposte – Melee attack that follows a parry (Fencer)
Fencer.Minor 1: Accurate Line Up – Enhance accuracy of next attack (Fencer)
Fencer.Minor 2: Battle Flow – Quicken following a parry (Fencer)
Fencer.Minor 3: Beat Blade – Reduce target parry chance (Fencer)
Fencer.Minor 4: Pinpoint Inspiration – Quicken self based on pinpoint value of last attack (Fencer)
Fencer.Minor 5: Pinpoint Stance – Gains expertise based on hit roll beyond that necessary to hit.  Increases accuracy and the value of pinpoint effects.  Advanced Pinpoint Stance grants all attacks a natural pinpoint effect. (Fencer)
Fencer.Minor 6: Push Response – Delay and flank next parried enemy.  Requires expertise (Fencer)
Fencer.Capstone Skill: Reactive Quickness — whenever the unit uses an ability with the reaction tag, they gain a minor quicken.

Lancer.Name: Lancer
Lancer.Description: A polearm and spear specialist whose Lancing Blow attacks have a chance to pierce through the primary target and hit the enemy behind them. Retaliation Stance generates expertise through retaliating, and she brings mounted abilities and column-targeting attacks that reward controlling space and threatening multiple rows at once.
Lancer.Major 1: Dash of Expertise – Melee attack versus a column that requires expertise and quickens the user (Lancer)
Lancer.Major 2: Expert Charge – Melee attack against column requiring mounted that is enhanced by expertise (Lancer)
Lancer.Major 3: Extended Penetration – Melee attack with penetration.  Next melee attack also has penetration based on expertise (Lancer)
Lancer.Major 4: Lancing Bleed – Melee attack that causes untyped bleed, procs the same attack against the target behind, with chance for behind that (Lancer)
Lancer.Major 5: Lancing Charge – Melee attack with momentum, procs the same attack against the target behind, with chance for behind that (Lancer)
Lancer.Major 6: Lancing Formation – Melee attack against row, procs the same attack against the target behind, with chance for behind that (Lancer)
Lancer.Major 7: Lancing Overrun – Melee attack that causes prone, procs the same attack against the target behind, with chance for behind that (Lancer)
Lancer.Major 8: Long Pierce – Melee attack that can strike any row (Lancer)
Lancer.Major 9: Long Skewer – Melee attack against column with bleed on critical (Lancer)
Lancer.Major 10: Mount Trade Holsteiner – Summons a trade holsteiner mount (Lancer)
Lancer.Major 11: Run Through – Melee attack versus a column that requires mana (Lancer)
Lancer.Major 12: Shatterlance – Melee attack with shattering and momentum, deals damage to all based on momentum (Lancer)
Lancer.Move 1: Dodge Stratagem – Spend expertise when next attacked to guarantee dodge (Lancer)
Lancer.Move 2: Expert Riding – Quicken and enhance damage of mount based on expertise.  Consumes expertise (Lancer)
Lancer.Move 3: Intercept Charge – Counter next attack with damage enhanced by target’s momentum (Lancer)
Lancer.Move 4: Lancing Follow-Up – Melee attack from mount against all enemies affected by lancing ability (Lancer)
Lancer.Move 5: Long Spear – Lancer can counter at range, but has reduced chance to counter.  Toggled (Lancer)
Lancer.Move 6: Mount’s Momentum – Grants the Lancer momentum at the beginning of her next turn based on her mount (Lancer)
Lancer.Move 7: Spiked Barding – Mount gains retaliation based on expertise (Lancer)
Lancer.Move 8: Steady Taunt – Taunts enemy and prevents Lancer from taking delays until next turn (Lancer)
Lancer.Minor 1: Bleeding Momentum – Damage all enemies based on momentum (Lancer)
Lancer.Minor 2: Prepare Momentum – Lose any current clock above max and regain at beginning of next turn (Lancer)
Lancer.Minor 3: Response Expertise – Taunt enemy and gain expertise on counter (Lancer)
Lancer.Minor 4: Retaliation Stance – Grants the fighter untyped retaliation or enhances present retaliation, generates expertise through retaliation (Lancer)
Lancer.Minor 5: Shattered Lance – Disarm self to deal untyped bleed damage to all enemies.  Follows attack (Lancer)
Lancer.Capstone Skill: Brace for Charge — the unit gains a defense bonus against each incoming attack scaled to the attacker's current momentum.

Samurai.Name: Samurai
Samurai.Description: An initiative-focused dual-wielder who seizes the opening of every battle with maximum aggression. Dodge Stance generates expertise on dodges, and Suicide Stance trades increased offense and counter-chance for the willingness to be struck, generating expertise from taking hits and rewarding an all-or-nothing fighting style.
Samurai.Weapon Mech: increased damage for a period after being damaged
Samurai.Major 1: Amplification Exploit – Amplified attack, consumes half of expertise, requires minimum expertise (Samurai)
Samurai.Major 2: Amplification Rend – Melee attack with both weapons that stacks amplification if both attacks hit. (Samurai)
Samurai.Major 3: Bushido Bleed – Melee attack against enemy that causes untyped bleed.  Enemy attack Samurai first and bleed is enhanced by enemy’s damage (Samurai)
Samurai.Major 4: Bushido Blow – Melee attack against enemy.  Enemy attacks Samurai first and damage enhanced by enemy’s damage (Samurai)
Samurai.Major 5: Bushido Burst – Melee attack against all enemies.  Target enemy attacks Samurai first and damage enhanced by enemy’s damage (Samurai)
Samurai.Major 6: Bushido Justice – Melee attack with justice against enemy.  Enemy attacks Samurai first and then its counter is set to 0 (Samurai)
Samurai.Major 7: Bushido Perseverance – Melee attack against enemy.  Each enemy in front row attacks Samurai first and damage enhanced by total enemies’ damage (Samurai)
Samurai.Major 8: Bushido Provocation – Melee attack against enemy that compels.  Enemy attacks Samurai first and damage enhanced by enemy’s damage (Samurai)
Samurai.Major 9: Double Bushido Strike – Two melee attack against enemy.  Enemy attacks Samurai first and damage enhanced by enemy’s damage (Samurai)
Samurai.Major 10: Double Slash – Two melee attacks with reduced accuracy.  Requires dual-wielding (Samurai)
Samurai.Major 11: Expert Decimation – Melee attack with decimation based on expertise, prepared (Samurai)
Samurai.Move 1: Accelerating Taunt – Taunts enemy and quickens self when damaged (Samurai)
Samurai.Move 2: Amplified Dodge – Enhance dodge and counter chance.  Amplified.  Consumes expertise (Samurai)
Samurai.Move 3: Armor Rend – Follows dual-wield attack.  Lowers enemy defense (Samurai)
Samurai.Move 4: Bushido Counter – Counter next attack against Samurai, with counter benefiting from damage enemy deals.  Delays Samurai (Samurai)
Samurai.Move 5: Disarming Response – Prepared ability.  Disarms enemy in response to enemy failing to disarm Samurai (Samurai)
Samurai.Move 6: Evasive Taunt – Taunts enemy and enhances dodge based on expertise (Samurai)
Samurai.Move 7: Expert Resistance – Enhances elemental resistance of the target.  This enhancement is increased by expertise if user is a fighter (Samurai)
Samurai.Move 8: Fuel the Strike – Target enemy attacks unit.  Unit gains enhanced damage to next attack based on damage taken (Samurai)
Samurai.Minor 1: Dodge Stance – Gains expertise whenever the fighter dodges an attack.  Increases dodge (Samurai)
Samurai.Minor 2: Dual Wield Expertise – Generate expertise following dual-wield attack (Samurai)
Samurai.Minor 3: Lure to Disaster – Quicken all enemies and enhance counter chance until next turn based on enemies quickened (Samurai)
Samurai.Minor 4: Shame – Target enemy that missed since it's last turn gains damage weakness (Samurai)
Samurai.Minor 5: Suicide Stance – Increases offense and chance to be countered.  Generates expertise when attacked.  This does not require the samurai to be hit. (Samurai)
Samurai.Minor 6: Violence Meets Violence – Melee attack following being criticaled during turn.  Requires dual wielding (Samurai)
Samurai.Capstone Skill: Battle Hardened — whenever the unit takes damage during its own turn from combat exchanges such as Bushido, counters, or retaliation, it gains enhanced dodge until its next turn.

Dreadnaught.Name: Dreadnaught
Dreadnaught.Description: An immovable defensive combatant who weaponizes his durability offensively. Unmovable Stance generates expertise from movement effects targeting him, and Advanced Unmovable Stance reflects delays back at enemies, turning every attempt to slow him into a punishment for the attacker.
Dreadnaught.Weapon Mech: bonus to next damage when quickened
Dreadnaught.Major 1: Counter Breaker – Melee attack that lowers target’s counter damage (Dreadnaught)
Dreadnaught.Major 2: Expert Shatter – Melee attack that has a shatter value based off expertise, needs to be prepared. (Dreadnaught)
Dreadnaught.Major 3: Fortifying Slash – Melee attack that grants user fortified, requires expertise (Dreadnaught)
Dreadnaught.Major 4: Garrison Blow – Melee attack that provokes target and enhances defense (Dreadnaught)
Dreadnaught.Major 5: Great Defense Strike - Melee attack that enhances defense.  Requires wielding a two-handed weapon (Dreadnaught)
Dreadnaught.Major 6: Stamina Blow – Melee attack boosted by endurance (Dreadnaught)
Dreadnaught.Major 7: Unstoppable Advance – Melee attack that causes additional delay based on unit’s defense (Dreadnaught)
Dreadnaught.Major 8: Unstoppable Blow – Melee attack deals extra damage based on unit’s defense (Dreadnaught)
Dreadnaught.Major 9: Unstoppable Collateral – Melee attack against single enemy that also damage all enemies based on defense (Dreadnaught)
Dreadnaught.Major 10: Unstoppable Critical – Melee attack that deals additional damage on critical based on defense.  Delays self (Dreadnaught)
Dreadnaught.Major 11: Unstoppable Destruction – Melee attack that lowers defense of target based on Dreadnaught’s defense.  Requires preparation (Dreadnaught)
Dreadnaught.Move 1: Armor Stratagem – Spend expertise when next attacked to turn attack into glancing blow (Dreadnaught)
Dreadnaught.Move 2: Defensive Provocation – Provoke enemy and reflect damage based on amount defended (Dreadnaught)
Dreadnaught.Move 3: Expert Prevention – Prevent portion of next damage based on expertise.  Consumes percentage of expertise (Dreadnaught)
Dreadnaught.Move 4: Fortified Stomp – Delay all enemies.  Requires fortify (Dreadnaught)
Dreadnaught.Move 5: Receive the Charge – Enemy deals less damage based on its own momentum (Dreadnaught)
Dreadnaught.Move 6: Unstoppable Purge – Enhances Dreadnaught defense, then purges based on defense (Dreadnaught)
Dreadnaught.Move 7: Unstoppable Shield – Enhance defense, then gain damage shield based on defense (Dreadnaught)
Dreadnaught.Minor 1: Dig In – Prevents movement effects until next turn and enhances damage of next attack based on movement effects (Dreadnaught)
Dreadnaught.Minor 2: Expert Vitality – Gain regeneration based on expertise, consuming all expertise (Dreadnaught)
Dreadnaught.Minor 3: Greataxe Block – Dreadnaught can block with two-handed weapon until next turn.  Enhances passive.  Requires and enhanced by expertise (Dreadnaught)
Dreadnaught.Minor 4: Parry Defense – Enhance defense on each parry before next turn (Dreadnaught)
Dreadnaught.Minor 5: Singular Defense – Gain damage shield against next attack, then lower defense until next turn (Dreadnaught)
Dreadnaught.Minor 6: Steady Footing – Cannot become knocked prone until next turn (Dreadnaught)
Dreadnaught.Minor 7: Unmovable Stance – Gains expertise whenever targeted by movement effects.  Reduces effects of movement effects. (Dreadnaught)
Dreadnaught.Capstone Skill: Growing Defenses - Each attack against Dreadnaught enhances defense until end of her turn.

Swashbuckler.Name: Swashbuckler
Swashbuckler.Description: A sword-fighting parry expert whose feint abilities compel enemies to attack her, then punish them when she parries the incoming strike. Parry Stance generates expertise from each successful parry, and she chains feints into ripostes, bleeds, penetrating attacks, or mass taunts depending on which feint variant she has prepared.
Swashbuckler.Major 1: Aorta Slash – Melee attack with penetrate that causes high damage, short term bleed (Swashbuckler)
Swashbuckler.Major 2: Bleeding Feint – Enhances parry chance of swashbuckler and compels target to attack her.  If she parries the target before next turn, she attacks the target and causes an untyped bleed.  Requires expertise (Swashbuckler)
Swashbuckler.Major 3: Desperate Hew – Melee attack with high critical chance and damage requiring endangered (Swashbuckler)
Swashbuckler.Major 4: Expert Blow, Supreme – Melee attack that requires expertise (Swashbuckler)
Swashbuckler.Major 5: Lucky Feint – Gain lucky on parries until next turn.  On parry, gain lucky accuracy and lucky damage and counter (Swashbuckler)
Swashbuckler.Major 6: Onslaught Feint – Enhances parry chance of swashbuckler and compels target to attack her.  If she parries the target before next turn, she attacks the target twice.  Requires expertise (Swashbuckler)
Swashbuckler.Major 7: Parried Fury – Series of three melee attacks that follow a parry (Swashbuckler)
Swashbuckler.Major 8: Parried Surge – Melee attack versus front row following a parry (Swashbuckler)
Swashbuckler.Major 9: Strike Off Balance – Melee attack that prevents target from countering until its next turn.  Requires expertise (Swashbuckler)
Swashbuckler.Major 10: Tripping Blow – Melee attack that has a chance to cause prone while having lower accuracy.  Requires expertise (Swashbuckler)
Swashbuckler.Major 11: Unerring Stroke – Unerring melee attack that consumes expertise (Swashbuckler)
Swashbuckler.Move 1: Control Exploit – Delay target and lower dodge and defense based on expertise, consumes all expertise (Swashbuckler)
Swashbuckler.Move 2: Expert Dodge – Enhances dodge of an ally.  Enhanced by expertise (Swashbuckler)
Swashbuckler.Move 3: Parried Understanding – Unparryable melee attack, follows a parry, requires expertise (Swashbuckler)
Swashbuckler.Move 4: Penetrating Feint – Enhances parry chance of swashbuckler and compels target to attack her.  If she parries the target before next turn, she attacks the target with penetrating.  Requires expertise and delays Swashbuckler (Swashbuckler)
Swashbuckler.Move 5: Pinpoint Feint – Enhances parry chance of swashbuckler and compels target to attack her.  If she parries the target before next turn, she attacks the target with pinpoint.  Requires expertise and delays Swashbuckler (Swashbuckler)
Swashbuckler.Move 6: Provoking Feint – Provokes all enemies to attack the swashbuckler.  Enhances her parry chance and quickens her with each parry (Swashbuckler)
Swashbuckler.Minor 1: Basic Feint – Enhances parry chance of swashbuckler and compels target to attack her.  If she parries the target before next turn, she attacks the target.  Requires expertise and delays the Swashbuckler (Swashbuckler)
Swashbuckler.Minor 2: Delaying Feint – Enhances parry chance of swashbuckler and compels target to attack her.  If she parries the target before next turn, she delays the target.  Requires expertise (Swashbuckler)
Swashbuckler.Minor 3: Parried Opening – Enhance critical chance following parry (Swashbuckler)
Swashbuckler.Minor 4: Parry Preference – Reduce dodge chance and increase parry until next turn (Swashbuckler)
Swashbuckler.Minor 5: Parry Stance – Gains expertise whenever the fighter parries an attack.  Increases parry chance (Swashbuckler)
Swashbuckler.Minor 6: Sharp Edge Parry – Damages enemies when the swashbuckler parries before next turn (Swashbuckler)
Swashbuckler.Minor 7: Swashbuckler Taunt – Compel target enemy and weaken accuracy after next parry.  Prepared (Swashbuckler)
Swashbuckler.Minor 8: Taunting Parry – Compels any enemy the Swashbuckler parries before next turn (Swashbuckler)
Swashbuckler.Capstone Skill: Responsive Parries – Whenever the Swashbuckler parries an attack, she also makes a counter attack.  She has a reduced chance to make counter attacks without parrying though.

Warlord.Name: Warlord
Warlord.Description: A commanding leader who translates her own expertise directly into team-wide benefits. Warlord's Stance generates expertise whenever any ally acts, and her Leadership abilities require a minimum expertise level and become more powerful at higher thresholds — quickening all allies, enhancing their damage, or even making their next attack unerring after she misses.
Warlord.Major 1: Allied Assistance – Warlord makes a melee attack against the target of each ally’s single target attack, consuming expertise with each attack (Warlord)
Warlord.Major 2: Directing Blow – Melee attack that enhances accuracy of all allies for their next attack based on expertise (Warlord)
Warlord.Major 3: Disruption Wave – Prepared melee attack versus all enemies that disrupts (Warlord)
Warlord.Major 4: Evading Blow – Melee attack that enhances dodge of all allies until their next attack based on expertise (Warlord)
Warlord.Major 5: Example of Expertise – Melee attack that gains increasing number of modifiers based on expertise, including sudden, unblockable, unparryable, unerring, and phasing.  Consumes expertise (Warlord)
Warlord.Major 6: Expert Instruction – Enhances damage of ally’s next attack based on total expertise (Warlord)
Warlord.Major 7: Galvanizing Blow – Melee attack that enhances damage of all allies for their next attack based on expertise (Warlord)
Warlord.Major 8: Powerful Exploit – Melee attack that consumes all expertise to increase damage.  Requires a minimum level of expertise (Warlord)
Warlord.Major 9: Provocation Blow – Melee attack that provokes target and enhances parry chance until target acts (Warlord)
Warlord.Major 10: Rallying Blow – Melee attack that quickens all allies based on expertise (Warlord)
Warlord.Major 11: Rallying Riposte – Prepared ability that counters following parry and quickens all allies (Warlord)
Warlord.Move 1: Animated Exploit – Consumes all expertise to quicken all allies.  Requires a minimum level of expertise (Warlord)
Warlord.Move 2: Expediting Taunt – Provoke enemy and quicken allies (Warlord)
Warlord.Move 3: Expert Education – Refreshes and updates all expert training abilities on team (Warlord)
Warlord.Move 4: Invigorating Exploit – Consumes all expertise to enhance damage of all allies.  Requires a minimum level of expertise (Warlord)
Warlord.Move 5: Parry Shards – Damage all enemies on next parry.  If this parries a critical attack, also inflict bleed (Warlord)
Warlord.Move 6: Target Order – Compel target ally and increase their time by half the time to act (Warlord)
Warlord.Move 7: War Party – Quickens all allies and enhances damage, requires expertise and preparation (Warlord)
Warlord.Minor 1: Aggressive Propulsion – Quicken based on damage of next attack (Warlord)
Warlord.Minor 2: Enduring Parry – Warlord gains enduring after parrying until next turn.  Prepared (Warlord)
Warlord.Minor 3: Expertise Observation – Alpha & Omega; gain expertise whenever an ally attacks until next turn (Warlord)
Warlord.Minor 4: Strike Like Me – Enhance ally’s critical chance and damage with next attack.  Follows critical (Warlord)
Warlord.Minor 5: Urged to Act – Quicken compelled ally (Warlord)
Warlord.Minor 6: Warlord’s Stance – Gains expertise whenever allies act.  Increases enhance effects and quickens on all allies. (Warlord)
Warlord.Minor 7: You Try – Ally’s next attack is unerring.  Follows miss (Warlord)
Warlord.Capstone Skill: Field Commander — Aid abilities used by the unit have enhanced effects and last two turns instead of one.

Bodyguard.Name: Bodyguard
Bodyguard.Weapon Mech: chance to ignore glancing hits at full health
Bodyguard.Capstone Skill: Protected Intercessions – Whenever the Bodyguard would take damage for an ally, the amount of damage received is reduced by this skill level.

Champion.Name: Champion
Champion.Capstone Skill: Constant Ire – Attacks from the Champion that deal overkill damage have a multiplier to the overkill value based on this passive.

Hospitaler.Name: Hospitaler
Hospitaler.Weapon Mech: increased healing and purge based on proximity to death
Hospitaler.Capstone Skill: Justice for the Infirm – The Hospitaler determines his justice modifier based on the character with the lowest health.

Cavalier.Name: Cavalier
Cavalier.Weapon Mech: chance to avoid block on attack
Cavalier.Capstone Skill: My Kingdom for a Horse - The Cavalier has a chance to be treated as mounted at the beginning of all turns.

Sentinel.Name: Sentinel
Sentinel.Weapon Name: Bec de Corbin and Bastion Shield

Black Knight.Name: Black Knight
Black Knight.Weapon Mech: bonus damage based on corruption on self
Black Knight.Capstone Skill: Initial Corruption - The Black Knight begins battle with a certain amount of corruption.

Crusader.Name: Crusader
Crusader.Weapon Mech: damage increases based on time since last action

Mercenary.Name: Mercenary
Mercenary.Capstone Skill: Rainbow Spectrum – The Mercenary deals increased damage for each element she has used during her turn.

Myrmidon.Name: Myrmidon
Myrmidon.Weapon Mech: increased damage while barrier is active

Minstrel.Name: Minstrel
Minstrel.Description: Crescendo-driven buffer who rewards spending small actions on allies to power up larger payoffs. Builds Crescendo stacks through move and minor buffs, then releases them through scaling heal, shield, damage, bleed, and mana abilities. Leans toward chords and positive effects, with strong regeneration support alongside his offensive Crescendo tools.
Minstrel.Capstone Skill: Swelling Enchantments – Until the first action of a unit after a Minstrel enchants them, the enchantment has an increased effect, based on this skill level.

Jester.Name: Jester
Jester.Description: Chaos-specialist who floods enemies with random afflictions, unpredictable conditions, and misdirected attacks. No formal mechanic — the unpredictability is the design. Best used to overwhelm enemy resistances and create openings for allies, with a capstone that turns his own misfortune into tempo.
Jester.Weapon Mech: increased effect and duration of enhancements and weaknesses on first turn
Jester.Capstone Skill: Pratfalls – Whenever the Jester becomes prone, he quickens all allies.  Whenever the Jester becomes disarmed, he deals ranged damage to a random enemy.  Both are based on this skill level.

Dirge Singer.Name: Dirge Singer
Dirge Singer.Description: The most offensively oriented bard subclass, specializing in life drain, culling, and damage-focused dischords rather than traditional support. He turns the song mechanic toward attrition and erasure — draining life, finishing weakened enemies, and using death itself as an element of his performance. Cacophony abilities reward the whole team's investment in debuffing, making him most dangerous in coordinated groups.
Dirge Singer.Capstone Skill: Mortal Harvest — Whenever the Dirge Singer kills an enemy with an instant kill effect (culling, ruthless, massive damage, or similar), he restores a percentage of his maximum health and a percentage of his maximum mana.

Balladeer.Name: Balladeer
Balladeer.Description: Earth-focused sustain specialist who stacks litany effects on allies and enemies for escalating pressure. Juggles short-duration stacking conditions that demand constant reapplication — letting them expire collapses the investment. Extended Cuts rewards commitment by progressively raising duration ceilings the more a condition is refreshed.
Balladeer.Weapon Mech: increased power of conditions already present on unit
Balladeer.Capstone Skill: Extended Cuts — Whenever the Balladeer applies a condition that already exists on the target, the maximum duration of that condition is increased. This effect can apply multiple times to the same condition.

Drummer.Name: Drummer
Drummer.Description: Elemental support and disruption specialist who grants deity-named favors to allies, healing them and loading them with elemental damage adds. Simultaneously harasses enemies with water and air magic, knockdowns, and delays. Favor of the Drum doubles every favor with a free untyped add, making his allies' attacks substantially more dangerous.
Drummer.Weapon Mech: minor quicken to all allies on turn
Drummer.Capstone Skill: Favor of the Drum — Whenever the Drummer grants an elemental damage add to an ally, that ally also receives an additional untyped damage add.

Spy.Name: Spy
Spy.Description: Stealth-integrated bard who supplements song management with disguises and flanking setups. Each disguise grants role-specific bonuses and can be dramatically discharged for a powerful effect at the cost of the disguise itself. Begins every battle already in disguise, giving immediate access to his full toolkit from the first action.
Spy.Capstone Skill: Initial Disguise - The Spy begins battle disguised.  Higher levels of this skill allow more disguise options.

Mountebank.Name: Mountebank
Mountebank.Description: Dark magic manipulator who fights most effectively when enemies cannot see him. Avert, scorn, and hidden each provide a different path to his veiled abilities, which hit harder than normal. Elusive Rhythm turns successful misdirection into tempo, rewarding a Mountebank who keeps multiple avoidance conditions active simultaneously.
Mountebank.Capstone Skill: Elusive Rhythm — Whenever an enemy is prevented from targeting the Mountebank due to a condition, the Mountebank is quickened.

Diva.Name: Diva
Diva.Description: Conductor-style support who grants allies free attacks through Entourage abilities, drawing enemy aggression onto protected performers. Provokes and taunts redirect incoming damage to allies who are simultaneously shielded, dodging, or enduring. Dedicated Entourage extends every provoke granted, making each protected performer absorb more before attention shifts.
Diva.Weapon Mech: increased magic damage but increased mana costs
Diva.Capstone Skill: Dedicated Entourage — Whenever the Diva grants a provoke to an ally, that provoke lasts for one additional instance.

Muse.Name: Muse
Muse.Description: Resurrection-focused support whose most powerful abilities unlock only after an ally returns to life. Epiphany abilities turn each resurrection into a cascade of heals, buffs, mana, and free attacks. His retaliation theme gives him an offensive identity when not raising allies, and Encore ensures he can survive long enough to finish his performance.
Muse.Capstone Skill: Encore — When the Muse is killed, he is granted one free resurrection on himself.

Lantern Bearer.Name: Lantern Bearer
Lantern Bearer.Description: Aura-and-light specialist who illuminates the battlefield to empower allies and punish enemies. Manages multiple sustained auras simultaneously while spreading illuminate to lock enemies out of hidden and set up targeted light abilities. Constant Light makes him a hard counter to all stealth-based enemy strategies, fundamentally reshaping how battles play out at Tier 25.
Lantern Bearer.Capstone Skill: Constant Light – No units can gain hidden in battle.

Conjurer.Name: Conjurer
Conjurer.Description: A summoner who fights in concert with her conjured allies, using their mana reserves to amplify her own attacks. She manifests spectral weapons for any ally and directs her companion with precision, growing stronger the more she and her creature act as one.
Conjurer.Capstone Skill: Death Throes – When a companion of the Conjurer would die, it makes one last attack.

Occultist.Name: Occultist
Occultist.Description: A Thanatos-leaning controller who wraps herself and allies in retaliatory spirits, punishing enemies for every strike they land. She pairs water and air magic for freeze and delay with a cross-alignment toolkit that rewards deliberate dips into Eros.
Occultist.Capstone Skill: Initial Retaliation – The Occultist deals additional damage the first-time retaliation triggers each time she gains it.

Shaman.Name: Shaman
Shaman.Description: A support specialist who prepares a battery of Attendant abilities and waits for her companion to critical — triggering all of them at once in a cascade of healing, damage, and quickening. The longer she waits, the more devastating the payoff.
Shaman.Capstone Skill: Critical Attendance – Whenever the Shaman scores a critical hit, her companion has an increased chance to critical during its turn.

Medium.Name: Medium
Medium.Description: A balanced-alignment caster who draws equal power from both dark and light, strongest when she resists pushing to either extreme. Her Harmony abilities detonate from center for massive effect, then push her off balance — and she spends the next turns clawing her way back.
Medium.Capstone Skill: Dualistic Power – Whenever the Medium increases one elemental power or resistance, she increases the opposed power by a percentage of that amount.

Animist.Name: Animist
Animist.Description: A spiritual warrior who infuses her companion with procs before it acts and rides a summoned Spirit Beast into mounted combat. She synchronizes her actions with her creature through a shared spiritual bond, raising fallen companions and granting her allies the will to survive past death.
Animist.Weapon Mech: bonus damage while companion is alive
Animist.Capstone Skill: Animated Persistence – Animation abilities from the Animist have a chance not to be consumed when they trigger.

Spiritualist.Name: Spiritualist
Spiritualist.Description: A desperation specialist whose entire toolkit unlocks at low health, becoming most powerful precisely when she should be most vulnerable. Her transformation locks in that endangered power permanently, turning near-death into a lasting combat state.
Spiritualist.Weapon Mech: endangered damage, bonus when both user and target are endangered
Spiritualist.Capstone Skill: Endangered Awakening – Whenever the Spiritualist becomes endangered, she quickens and gains enhanced magic power with her next turn.

Astrologer.Name: Astrologer
Astrologer.Description: A critical-hit amplifier who builds toward celestial thresholds across multiple turns, generating mana, quickening herself, and purging afflictions with each enemy she crits. She wields the full elemental spectrum through a stellar lens, with her lucky damage toolkit turning probability itself into a weapon.
Astrologer.Weapon Mech: increased damage for each enemy damaged during turn
Astrologer.Capstone Skill: Sea of Stars – Whenever the Astrologer scores enough critical hits, she triggers a light magic attack against all enemies.

Vizier.Name: Vizier
Vizier.Description: A selfish corruptor who damages her own allies to fuel her offensive power, scaling with the total corruption she spreads across the battlefield. She transforms her own self-inflicted corruption into a permanent power state, and turns enemy deaths into mana through Dark Harvest.
Vizier.Capstone Skill: Dark Harvest – Whenever a unit with corruption on it dies, the Vizier restores mana based on the level of corruption.

Alienist.Name: Alienist
Alienist.Description: A sanity-sacrificing chaos mage who deliberately accumulates illusory damage on herself to unlock her most powerful abilities. She cannot be killed by her own madness — but when it expires, it becomes very real, making resource management a matter of survival.
Alienist.Capstone Skill: Life of Insanity – The Alienist cannot die from illusory damage, but when illusory damage expires, it is converted into real damage based on the level of this passive.

Pact Master.Name: Pact Master
Pact Master.Description: A high-commitment alignment specialist who signs powerful ongoing Pacts, each granting two bonuses at the cost of one persistent drawback. She thrives at the extremes of the alignment scale, and her Lifebond with her companion means their fates are literally intertwined — she cannot fall while it stands.
Pact Master.Weapon Mech: intrinsic heal siphon and pain link with companion
Pact Master.Capstone Skill: Lifebond – Whenever the Pact Master would be dealt lethal damage while she has a companion, she survives with one health and all overflow damage is dealt to her companion.

Acolyte.Name: Acolyte
Acolyte.Description: Quick and affordable support built around lucky manipulation and regeneration. Generates divinity through hexes, purges, and blessings, then spends it on Benedictions — powerful single-target heals enhanced by current divinity, with overheal effects that range from possession to damage to speed depending on the type used.
Acolyte.Capstone Skill: Assisted Overheals – Overheals from the Acolyte include a percentage of all health restored, based on the level of this skill.

Healer.Name: Healer
Healer.Description: Pure restoration specialist with the mana economy to sustain heavy healing across a long battle. His cures carry addenda that scale with heal value, turning strong heals into purges, quickens, or damage adds. A Life Domain running on overheal generation lets him convert aggressive healing directly into sustained divinity.

Disciple.Name: Disciple
Disciple.Description: Affliction-resistant purge specialist who turns enemy pressure into elemental retaliation. Elemental purges double as generators and resistance enhancers scaled to current divinity, and a Protection Domain that rewards affliction resistance creates a feedback loop where enemy affliction pressure fuels his own power.
Disciple.Capstone Skill: Reactive Resistance – The Disciple gains elemental resistance based on the last element that damaged him.

Priest.Name: Priest
Priest.Description: Magically aggressive Cleric who layers blessings onto allies while maintaining his own damage shield as an offensive weapon. The Lattice ability line scales with and consumes his shield for light damage and control, Lattice Reflection punishes enemies who target it, and a Sun Domain that generates from light abilities rewards sustained Celestial offense.

Combat Medic.Name: Combat Medic
Combat Medic.Description: Frontline healer built for endangered allies and active combat. Vitality heals grant temporary bonuses that persist until the target takes damage, and a War Domain that generates from any ally's critical hits rewards pairing him with damage-heavy parties. Perilous Divinity marks low-health targets for stronger healing while generating divinity.
Combat Medic.Capstone Skill: Conserve Vitality - The Combat Medic has a chance to keep vitality buffs when damaged based on this passive.

Exorcist.Name: Exorcist
Exorcist.Description: Light-magic specialist with exclusive access to intangible enemies and strong mana drain. Most abilities gain additional effects against incorporeal targets, and an Exorcism Domain that generates divinity proportional to total enemy mana spent rewards fighting caster-heavy encounters where the domain becomes a powerful self-sustaining engine.
Exorcist.Capstone Skill: Exorcism – Attacks against intangible enemies have a chance to automatically kill them based on their low health and mana.

Preacher.Name: Preacher
Preacher.Description: Sleep-focused controller who worships the sleeping god and grows in power while the world slumbers. Incapacitated allies feed Rest Domain divinity generation even without the Preacher acting, turning sleep from a liability into a resource. Turns ally afflictions into advantages and punishes sleeping enemies with a focused suite of nightmare attacks.
Preacher.Weapon Mech: increased incapacitate potency and landing chance

Zealot.Name: Zealot
Zealot.Description: High-speed melee Cleric who conducts the entire party's tempo through quickening. Ascension abilities require but do not spend full divinity, creating a maintain-and-hold pattern rather than the typical spend-and-rebuild cycle. A mastery class at Tier 19 — maximizing output requires deep awareness of quicken tolerance, Ascension timing, and Fervor Domain generation simultaneously.
Zealot.Weapon Mech: increased damage and speed when alone

Plague Doctor.Name: Plague Doctor
Plague Doctor.Description: Self-infecting contagion spreader who carries disease deliberately to fuel his domain. Plague Domain generates divinity for each affliction successfully transferred from the Plague Doctor to an enemy, rewarding stacking afflictions on himself and building around affliction resistance to survive the risk. One of the most dangerous and mechanically demanding Cleric subclasses.
Plague Doctor.Capstone Skill: Plague Bearer - The Plague Doctor begins battle with contagion that has a chance to spread afflictions to enemies instead.

Oracle.Name: Oracle
Oracle.Description: Capstone Cleric whose Furtherance abilities scale with divinity gained during the current turn rather than total on hand. Front-loading a turn with support actions directly amplifies his payoff. A Prophecy Domain that generates divinity when countdowns fire — scaled to their duration — rewards patience and long-term planning over reactive play.
Oracle.Weapon Mech: increased countdown duration, attacks increase countdown power

Buccaneer.Name: Buccaneer
Buccaneer.Capstone Skill: Enhanced Potential – Whenever the Buccaneer uses an ability that is based on the value of a damage affliction, the value is considered greater, based on this skill level.

Executioner.Name: Executioner
Executioner.Weapon Mech: extra damage against lowest health enemy
Executioner.Capstone Skill: Critical Execution – The Executioner deals increased critical damage if the target has the lowest health.

Gravedigger.Name: Gravedigger
Gravedigger.Capstone Skill: Burial Proc – The modified skill has a chance to afflict the target with burial.

Hangman.Name: Hangman
Hangman.Weapon Mech: increased damage based on tired duration on target

Harbinger.Name: Harbinger
Harbinger.Weapon Mech: extra damage to next ally attacking same target
Harbinger.Capstone Skill: Constant Moon – Moon automatically appears in battle, determined by game calendar, at a lesser power.

Sin Eater.Name: Sin Eater
Sin Eater.Weapon Mech: increased damage after purging or disenchanting
Sin Eater.Capstone Skill: Sinful Vapors - The Sin Eater gains mana whenever any affliction is purged.

Sandman.Name: Sandman
Sandman.Weapon Mech: attacks have chance to be insidious
Sandman.Capstone Skill: Nightmare Manifest – Whenever incapacitated is removed from the Sandman, he deals illusory damage to all enemies based on the period he was incapacitated.

Whisperer.Name: Whisperer
Whisperer.Weapon Mech: increased damage against more enemies present
Whisperer.Capstone Skill: Whispering Maladies - The Whisperer has improved affliction power based on total number of enemies.

Telepath.Name: Telepath
Telepath.Description: The entry point for deep influence play. The Telepath specializes in illusory damage and disruption, with heightened abilities that let her translate influence investment into cascading multi-cast effects. She is subtle and methodical, chipping away at enemy defenses before they can act.
Telepath.Weapon Mech: dodge and reflection bonus after attacking
Telepath.Major 1: Confusion Spike – Arcane magic attack and confuse. (Telepath)
Telepath.Major 2: Disorienting Wave – Stuns and disrupts each enemy based on influence. (Telepath)
Telepath.Major 3: Heightened Disruption Spike – Magic attack that disrupts. If the Telepath has extra mana when used, repeats based on influence and available mana against random targets. (Telepath)
Telepath.Major 4: Heightened Flame – Fire magic damage. If the Telepath has extra mana when used, repeats against the same enemy with each extra cast. (Telepath)
Telepath.Major 5: Heightened Illusion – Afflicts target with illusory damage. If the Telepath has extra mana when used, repeats based on influence and available mana against random targets. (Telepath)
Telepath.Major 6: Heightened Possession – Possesses target. If the Telepath has extra mana when used, repeats based on influence and available mana against random targets. (Telepath)
Telepath.Major 7: Heightened Sleep – Incapacitates target. If the Telepath has extra mana when used, repeats based on influence and available mana against random targets. (Telepath)
Telepath.Major 8: Insightful Strike – Magic attack against single enemy, generates influence and displays target health. (Telepath)
Telepath.Major 9: Invade Dreams – Insidious magic attack versus incapacitated enemies enhanced by influence. (Telepath)
Telepath.Major 10: Pyrokinetic Vulnerability – Afflict all enemies with a minimum level of influence with fire vulnerability. (Telepath)
Telepath.Major 11: Telepathic Channel – Channeled ability that consumes influence over a period to deal fire damage. (Telepath)
Telepath.Move 1: Full Clarity – Purges all illusory damage from both allies and enemies. (Telepath)
Telepath.Move 2: Heightened Disenchantment – Disenchants target enemy. If the Telepath has extra mana when used, repeats based on influence and available mana against random targets. (Telepath)
Telepath.Move 3: Heightened Stun – Stuns target. If the Telepath has extra mana when used, repeats based on influence and available mana, extending stun duration. (Telepath)
Telepath.Move 4: Proactive Disruption – If target prepared an ability last turn, that ability has a chance to be disrupted. (Telepath)
Telepath.Move 5: Reactive Disruption – Any enemy that prepares an ability before the Telepath's next turn has a chance to be disrupted. Lower success chance than targeted disruption. (Telepath)
Telepath.Move 6: Telepathic Feedback – Stuns any enemy that attacks the Telepath before her next turn. (Telepath)
Telepath.Move 7: Timid Field – Causes counter weakness and damage weakness to all enemies. Can be maintained for reduced cost. (Telepath)
Telepath.Minor 1: Ascend to Great Heights – Generates mana based on number of prepared heightened abilities. (Telepath)
Telepath.Minor 2: Disconnect – Removes all influence from one target. Quickens the Telepath based on the square root of influence removed. (Telepath)
Telepath.Minor 3: Enchantment Wildsurge – Randomizes the duration of enchantments used by the Telepath, using Wild Surge mechanics. (Telepath)
Telepath.Minor 4: Lingering Force – Follows using influence. Gain damage shield based on influence spent. (Telepath)
Telepath.Minor 5: Mote of Joy – Positive. Enhances accuracy of all allies and grants focus to a random ally on the Telepath's turn based on total influence. (Telepath)
Telepath.Minor 6: Warning Thought – Purges flanked status from all allies. (Telepath)
Telepath.Minor 7: Wild Surge – Next attack deals between 75% and 150% damage, enhanced by influence. (Telepath)
Telepath.Capstone Skill: Greater Heights – Heightened abilities cost less mana for each extra cast.

Kinetic.Name: Kinetic
Kinetic.Description: A spread-oriented damage dealer who turns punishment into power. Her kinetic abilities charge between turns based on physical damage she absorbs, making her uniquely dangerous when enemies focus on her. She favors broad pressure and area control over single-target dominance.
Kinetic.Weapon Mech: ranged damage based on magic power
Kinetic.Major 1: Drain Heat – Cold damage using fire power. Quickens the unit based on damage dealt. (Kinetic)
Kinetic.Major 2: Ectoplasmic Goo – Arcane magic damage and slow versus single enemy. (Kinetic)
Kinetic.Major 3: Energy Reversal – Channeled magic ability. Reduces damage taken while channeled, then deals damage equal to damage reduced to all enemies when the channel ends. (Kinetic)
Kinetic.Major 4: Flame, Greater – Fire magic damage versus single enemy. (Kinetic)
Kinetic.Major 5: Impaling Telekinesis – Magic attack with penetrate that causes untyped bleed. (Kinetic)
Kinetic.Major 6: Kinetic Beam – Magic attack versus column that delays targets and gains power from physical damage caused between preparation and use. (Kinetic)
Kinetic.Major 7: Kinetic Blast – Magic attack versus all that gains power from physical damage caused between preparation and use. (Kinetic)
Kinetic.Major 8: Kinetic Crush – Magic attack versus single that lowers defense and gains power from physical damage caused between preparation and use. (Kinetic)
Kinetic.Major 9: Kinetic Delay – Low-powered arcane damage versus all that deals delay based on physical damage dealt between preparation and use. (Kinetic)
Kinetic.Major 10: Kinetic Deterioration – Untyped magic bleed requiring momentum. (Kinetic)
Kinetic.Major 11: Kinetic Wave – Magic attack that causes delay enhanced by influence. (Kinetic)
Kinetic.Major 12: Mindfire – Deal fire damage to all enemies enhanced by total influence. (Kinetic)
Kinetic.Major 13: Momentum Bolt – Arcane magic attack requiring momentum. (Kinetic)
Kinetic.Move 1: Dampen Burst – Reduces the damage of the next area damage effect to the target team. (Kinetic)
Kinetic.Move 2: Enhance Momentum – Increases the momentum value of the next ability used. (Kinetic)
Kinetic.Move 3: Kinetic Block – Gain block chance until next turn. On block, enhance defense of the team. (Kinetic)
Kinetic.Move 4: Kinetic Momentum – Quickens ally and grants them momentum based on physical damage caused between preparation and use. (Kinetic)
Kinetic.Move 5: Kinetic Shield – Enchants ally with a damage shield enhanced by physical damage caused between preparation and use. (Kinetic)
Kinetic.Move 6: Kinetic Surge – Delays all enemies by a percentage of their current timer. Generates influence on enemies above 500 timer threshold. (Kinetic)
Kinetic.Minor 1: Chaos Elemental Wildsurge – Randomizes the element of all attacks used by the Kinetic and enhances their damage by a random amount, using Wild Surge mechanics. (Kinetic)
Kinetic.Minor 2: Draining Momentum – Delay all enemies based on momentum. (Kinetic)
Kinetic.Minor 3: Immediate Influence – Gain influence over enemy. Requires momentum. (Kinetic)
Kinetic.Minor 4: Mote of Anger – Positive. Enhances damage and quickens all allies on the Kinetic's turn based on total influence. (Kinetic)
Kinetic.Minor 5: Pyrokinetic Dampen – Lowers damage of next fire effect used by enemies. (Kinetic)
Kinetic.Minor 6: Telekinetic Grip – Delays enemy suffering from influence. (Kinetic)
Kinetic.Capstone Skill: Kinetic Control – The Kinetic gains kinetic bonuses from own physical damage.

Amnesiac.Name: Amnesiac
Amnesiac.Description: A denial specialist who erodes the enemy's ability to function. She burns through mana, forces enemies into basic attacks, and makes them forget what they were doing. She also carries an unexpected compassionate edge, helping allies forget their wounds.
Amnesiac.Weapon Mech: procs avert on target when attacking
Amnesiac.Major 1: Amplified Forgetfulness – Causes all enemies to lose mana with amplification on each use. If any enemy ends up with zero mana, deals damage based on the extra mana lost and resets amplification. (Amnesiac)
Amnesiac.Major 2: Bleeding Memory – Afflicts target with mana burn and illusory bleed. (Amnesiac)
Amnesiac.Major 3: Burning Mind – Fire magic attack versus target with mana burn. Triggers mana burn effect on all enemies. (Amnesiac)
Amnesiac.Major 4: Flame Beam – Fire magic attack versus column. (Amnesiac)
Amnesiac.Major 5: Forget Your Mind – Forces target to use only its basic attack for a period. Duration scales with influence. (Amnesiac)
Amnesiac.Major 6: Forgotten Blessing – Magic attack that disenchants target and causes mana loss. Mana loss and damage are based on enchantment disenchanted. (Amnesiac)
Amnesiac.Major 7: Forsaken Bolt – Arcane magic attack that afflicts target with forsaken, preventing target from gaining enchantments. (Amnesiac)
Amnesiac.Major 8: Mass Mana Burn – Afflict all enemies with mana burn. (Amnesiac)
Amnesiac.Major 9: Mental Crash – Prepared ability that triggers when the next enemy falls below a health threshold. Deals damage and stuns that enemy. (Amnesiac)
Amnesiac.Major 10: Simple Masses – Forces all influenced enemies to use their next basic attack. (Amnesiac)
Amnesiac.Major 11: Traumatic Memory – Prepared ability that deals illusory damage equal to last damage dealt to target. (Amnesiac)
Amnesiac.Move 1: Antipathy – Grant self ongoing scorn with target enemy. (Amnesiac)
Amnesiac.Move 2: Forget Me – Causes aversion with each enemy and provides influence over each affected. (Amnesiac)
Amnesiac.Move 3: Forgotten Health – Magic attack that deals damage to target based on the last heal it received. Prepared. (Amnesiac)
Amnesiac.Move 4: Forgotten Manipulation – Triggers mana burn on target outside of their turn, including overflow health damage. (Amnesiac)
Amnesiac.Move 5: Forgotten Wound – Restores health to target ally based on last damage taken. (Amnesiac)
Amnesiac.Move 6: Mental Mist – Requires influence. Prevents a random influenced enemy from using targeted abilities on their next turn. (Amnesiac)
Amnesiac.Move 7: Returning Memory – Countdown ability that generates mana for the Amnesiac. (Amnesiac)
Amnesiac.Minor 1: Affliction Resistance Wildsurge – Randomizes the affliction resistance of the Amnesiac using Wild Surge mechanics. Generated at the beginning of her turn. (Amnesiac)
Amnesiac.Minor 2: Emergency Influence – Generate influence on all enemies if endangered. (Amnesiac)
Amnesiac.Minor 3: False Notion – Cause unlucky accuracy for single target's next attack. (Amnesiac)
Amnesiac.Minor 4: Forgotten Malady – Removes any afflictions caused to target ally since last turn. (Amnesiac)
Amnesiac.Minor 5: Illusory Regeneration – Reduces illusory damage over time. (Amnesiac)
Amnesiac.Minor 6: Mote of Lethargy – Negative. Weakens enemy mana generation and slows a random enemy on the Amnesiac's turn based on total influence. (Amnesiac)
Amnesiac.Minor 7: Mystical Ecstasy – Gain mana if endangered. (Amnesiac)
Amnesiac.Capstone Skill: Brainburning Strikes – Whenever the Amnesiac attacks an enemy with mana burn, she triggers that affliction on the target.

Hypnotist.Name: Hypnotist
Hypnotist.Description: A pattern-weaver who controls the entire battlefield through sustained channeled effects. She locks enemies into states of blindness, stun, or vulnerability for as long as she can keep her focus. Patient and methodical, she rewards players who plan their turns carefully.
Hypnotist.Major 1: Burning Gaze – Channeled ability that causes fire damage for the duration of the channel and fire bleed on critical. (Hypnotist)
Hypnotist.Major 2: Caustic Stare – Channeled ability that causes earth vulnerability and earth bleed for the duration of the channel. (Hypnotist)
Hypnotist.Major 3: Dream and Nightmare – If target is not incapacitated, incapacitate them. If they are incapacitated, remove incapacitation and deal high damage. (Hypnotist)
Hypnotist.Major 4: Fires of Command – Piercing fire magic attack that possesses the target if enough resistance is ignored. Possession chance increased by influence on target. (Hypnotist)
Hypnotist.Major 5: Hydrokinesis – Water bleed and delay based on influence on target. (Hypnotist)
Hypnotist.Major 6: Hypnotic Pattern – Channeled ability that stuns enemies for the duration of the channel. (Hypnotist)
Hypnotist.Major 7: Maddening Pattern – Channeled ability that causes illusory damage and lowers affliction resistance for the duration of the channel. (Hypnotist)
Hypnotist.Major 8: Pendulum Swing – Magic attack that generates influence and delays target. (Hypnotist)
Hypnotist.Major 9: Psychic Blast – Untyped magic attack versus all influenced, with minimum damage based on influence on each individual target and maximum damage based on total influence. (Hypnotist)
Hypnotist.Major 10: Scintillating Pattern – Channeled ability that blinds enemies for the duration of the channel. (Hypnotist)
Hypnotist.Major 11: Scorn Pulse – Magic damage versus all influenced and gain scorn. (Hypnotist)
Hypnotist.Major 12: Stunned Command – Possess all stunned enemies. (Hypnotist)
Hypnotist.Move 1: Broken Pattern – All enemies gain fragile for the duration of the channel. (Hypnotist)
Hypnotist.Move 2: Channeled Memory – Gain mana based on the duration of the previous turn's channel. (Hypnotist)
Hypnotist.Move 3: Distracting Pattern – Channeled ability that distracts all enemies for the duration of the channel. (Hypnotist)
Hypnotist.Move 4: Jinx Pattern – All enemies have reduced accuracy and are jinxed while this ability is channeled. (Hypnotist)
Hypnotist.Move 5: Piercing Pattern – Lower elemental resistance of all enemies for the duration of the channel. (Hypnotist)
Hypnotist.Move 6: Readied Channel – Increases the duration of the next channel. (Hypnotist)
Hypnotist.Move 7: Sieve Pattern – Channeled ability that reduces mana generation of all enemies for the duration of the channel. (Hypnotist)
Hypnotist.Minor 1: Dream Scan – Gain high influence with an incapacitated enemy. (Hypnotist)
Hypnotist.Minor 2: Illusory Pattern – Channeled ability that extends illusory damage on all enemies for the duration of the channel. (Hypnotist)
Hypnotist.Minor 3: Mote of Emptiness – Negative. Weakens affliction resistance of enemies and incapacitates a random enemy on the Hypnotist's turn based on total influence. (Hypnotist)
Hypnotist.Minor 4: Pausing Intimidation – Avert target, delay, and gain influence. (Hypnotist)
Hypnotist.Minor 5: Retaliation Wildsurge – Grants the Hypnotist retaliation based on total influence, using Wild Surge mechanics. (Hypnotist)
Hypnotist.Minor 6: Snap Awake – Purge incapacitated from target enemy and possess it. (Hypnotist)
Hypnotist.Capstone Skill: Lingering Patterns - Patterns remain active for a period after channeling starts.

Diviner.Name: Diviner
Diviner.Description: An information broker and countdown specialist who fights the future rather than the present. Her divinations expose enemy weaknesses and upcoming actions, letting the whole party respond intelligently, while her countdown abilities punish enemies for the passage of time itself.
Diviner.Major 1: Death Prediction – Magic attack with culling. Both culling and damage are enhanced by influence. (Diviner)
Diviner.Major 2: Disastrous Foresight – Deals illusory damage to all enemies based on their current countdown values. (Diviner)
Diviner.Major 3: Divination Strike – Magic attack with increased critical chance that cannot be countered. (Diviner)
Diviner.Major 4: Diviner's Blast – Arcane magic attack versus all. (Diviner)
Diviner.Major 5: Diviner's Bolt – Arcane unerring magic attack versus single. (Diviner)
Diviner.Major 6: Future Betrayal – Possess any influenced enemy over a given timer threshold. (Diviner)
Diviner.Major 7: Influence Prediction – Countdown against single enemy that generates high influence when it triggers. (Diviner)
Diviner.Major 8: Influenced Countdown – Causes untyped countdown on target enhanced by influence. (Diviner)
Diviner.Major 9: Mass Prediction – Afflict all influenced enemies with untyped countdown. (Diviner)
Diviner.Major 10: Rewrite Fate – Transfer all countdowns from afflicted allies to target enemy. (Diviner)
Diviner.Major 11: Spell Predetermination – Arcane magic attack that causes the target's next spell to be countered. (Diviner)
Diviner.Move 1: Critical Misfortune – Possess the next enemy to make a critical attack. (Diviner)
Diviner.Move 2: Death Misfortune – Incapacitate the next enemy to kill an allied unit. (Diviner)
Diviner.Move 3: Detect Action – Shows the next action of all enemies. (Diviner)
Diviner.Move 4: Detect Health – Shows the numeric health of all enemies. (Diviner)
Diviner.Move 5: Detect Initiative – Shows the timer of all enemies. (Diviner)
Diviner.Move 6: Detect Weakness – Shows the lowest elemental resist of all enemies. (Diviner)
Diviner.Move 7: Dodge Misfortune – Afflict the next enemy dodged with an untyped countdown. (Diviner)
Diviner.Minor 1: Detect Mana – Shows the mana amount of all enemies. (Diviner)
Diviner.Minor 2: Detect Target – Shows the current target of all enemies. (Diviner)
Diviner.Minor 3: Dodge Wildsurge – Randomizes the dodge of the Diviner, using Wild Surge mechanics. (Diviner)
Diviner.Minor 4: Mote of Ecstasy – Positive. Enhances healing received of allies and grants an illusory add to attack on the Diviner's turn based on total influence. (Diviner)
Diviner.Minor 5: Predict Placement – Target's next attack gains unerring. Does not work with attacks with reduced accuracy. (Diviner)
Diviner.Minor 6: Spell Critical Prediction – Enhance spell critical of ally until end of target's next turn. (Diviner)
Diviner.Minor 7: Spell Dodge Prediction – Enhance spell dodge of ally until end of target's next turn. (Diviner)
Diviner.Capstone Skill: Double Divination – The Diviner can maintain two divination effects at a time.

Haunted.Name: Haunted
Haunted.Description: A ghost-touched subclass who exploits enemies at their weakest — specifically when their mana runs dry. She drains, haunts, and possesses with impunity against vulnerable targets, and can become intangible herself to frighten and evade. Death Knell makes her the safest handler of deep influence.
Haunted.Major 1: Call to Conflict – Possess two random enemies to attack one another. (Haunted)
Haunted.Major 2: Fated Superstition – Afflicts target with low mana with fire countdown. Deals extra damage if target is at low mana when it triggers. (Haunted)
Haunted.Major 3: Final Possession – Arcane attack against single enemy that possesses if it kills. (Haunted)
Haunted.Major 4: Haunting Chant – Channeled ability that lowers the target's mana and deals damage based on how low it is. (Haunted)
Haunted.Major 5: Paranoid Superstition – Possesses all enemies with influence that are at low mana. (Haunted)
Haunted.Major 6: Piercing Superstition – Arcane magic attack with piercing and phasing against a target with low mana. (Haunted)
Haunted.Major 7: Poltergeist Ailment – Unlucky accuracy, jinx, and untyped hex. (Haunted)
Haunted.Major 8: Poltergeist Pain – Magic attack that possesses the target on a critical hit. (Haunted)
Haunted.Major 9: Poltergeist Tantrum – Arcane storm that can be sustained for reduced mana cost. (Haunted)
Haunted.Major 10: Superstitious Hex – Arcane hex against target enemy whose value is determined by how low the target's mana is. (Haunted)
Haunted.Major 11: Unseen Superstition – Arcane magic attack against low mana that flanks. (Haunted)
Haunted.Move 1: Become a Ghost – Gain intangible and frighten all enemies. Lasts multiple turns at a single upfront mana cost. (Haunted)
Haunted.Move 2: Death Knell – Cull an enemy with influence without triggering feedback. (Haunted)
Haunted.Move 3: Grief Eternal – Target enemy takes damage on its next attacks based on influence and damage dealt. (Haunted)
Haunted.Move 4: Haunting Banality – Causes a mana bleed affliction on target. (Haunted)
Haunted.Move 5: Remorse – Damage mana and stun if mana becomes zero. (Haunted)
Haunted.Move 6: Sapping Field – Lowers the magic power of all enemies. Can be maintained for reduced cost. (Haunted)
Haunted.Move 7: Sleepy Superstition – Afflicts target with low mana with incapacitated. (Haunted)
Haunted.Minor 1: Affliction Duration Wildsurge – Randomizes the duration of any afflictions used by the Haunted, using Wild Surge mechanics. (Haunted)
Haunted.Minor 2: Crippling Maladies – Delay each enemy based on afflictions they are suffering. (Haunted)
Haunted.Minor 3: Deathly Influence – Gain influence over all endangered enemies. (Haunted)
Haunted.Minor 4: Flee the Body – Prepared ability to become intangible in response to possession. (Haunted)
Haunted.Minor 5: Haunting Power – Enhance magic power. Requires intangible. (Haunted)
Haunted.Minor 6: Lingering Flames – Gain retaliation following using a fire spell. (Haunted)
Haunted.Minor 7: Mote of Fear – Negative. Weakens counter chance of enemies and frightens a random enemy on the Haunted's turn based on total influence. (Haunted)
Haunted.Capstone Skill: Haunted Spells - Spells have increased effect on low mana targets.

Mastermind.Name: Mastermind
Mastermind.Description: The party coordinator. Rather than dominating enemies directly, she possesses allies to direct them more efficiently and uses total influence to synchronize team timing. She rewards players who understand their whole roster and rewards smart sequencing over raw power.
Mastermind.Major 1: Allied Influence – Target ally influences enemies with each attack during their next turn. One influence per attack per target. Benefits allies with multi-hit or area attacks. (Mastermind)
Mastermind.Major 2: Compelling Ploy – Possesses ally who then compels the target of its attack. (Mastermind)
Mastermind.Major 3: Counter Ploy – Magic attack that requires influence on target. Target's next attack is countered. (Mastermind)
Mastermind.Major 4: Defensive Possession – Possesses ally and enhances their defense. (Mastermind)
Mastermind.Major 5: Ghost Ploy – Grant ally intangible and possess it. (Mastermind)
Mastermind.Major 6: Hyperawareness – Channeled ability that grants all allies guaranteed counters while ongoing. (Mastermind)
Mastermind.Major 7: Illusory Ploy – Possesses ally for an attack that deals damage as illusory. (Mastermind)
Mastermind.Major 8: Influence Ploy – Possesses ally to attack a random enemy. Enemy becomes influenced. (Mastermind)
Mastermind.Major 9: Inspiring Possession – Possess ally; ally gains mana. (Mastermind)
Mastermind.Major 10: Mana Reverberation – Damages all enemies based on their current mana. (Mastermind)
Mastermind.Major 11: Mastermind Attack – Quicken all allies and delay all enemies based on total influence. Any ally quickened over timer makes an instant attack. (Mastermind)
Mastermind.Major 12: Possessed by Delusions – Remove illusory damage from each enemy to possess it. (Mastermind)
Mastermind.Major 13: Quickening Ploy – Possesses ally to attack a random enemy. Quickens the Mastermind and the ally based on ally's damage. (Mastermind)
Mastermind.Move 1: Attack Impetus – Grants ally immediate attack based on its timer, with higher timer being more powerful. (Mastermind)
Mastermind.Move 2: Dimension Swap – Change timers with ally, who gets an immediate turn minus a minor action. (Mastermind)
Mastermind.Move 3: Emergency Ploy – Target endangered ally gains an immediate action. (Mastermind)
Mastermind.Move 4: Mana Siphon, Allied – Mastermind gains a portion of mana used by allies until next turn. (Mastermind)
Mastermind.Move 5: Psionic Conduit – Target ally can use mana from the Mastermind's mana pool until next turn. (Mastermind)
