Mastermind.Move 6: Touch of Allegiance – Target ally attacks next enemy to act. Does not work if that enemy attacks target. (Mastermind)
Mastermind.Move 7: Turn Speed – Either purge target of slow and quicken them or grant them haste. (Mastermind)
Mastermind.Minor 1: Borrowed Time – Prepared ability that quickens self or ally. (Mastermind)
Mastermind.Minor 2: Efficiency Wildsurge – Randomizes the mana cost of abilities used by the Mastermind, using Wild Surge mechanics. (Mastermind)
Mastermind.Minor 3: Mindlock – Prevents target from changing the action of their previous turn. If that action is impossible, their turn is lost. Requires influence. (Mastermind)
Mastermind.Minor 4: Mote of Laughter – Positive. Enhances dodge of allies and possesses a random ally on the Mastermind's turn based on total influence. (Mastermind)
Mastermind.Minor 5: Possession Guidance – Next target possessed by the Mastermind gains an untyped damage add to its attack. (Mastermind)

Mindbleeder.Name: Mindbleeder
Mindbleeder.Description: A high-risk, high-reward glass cannon who bleeds the mind as much as the body. She deals devastating illusory damage that grows stronger the closer she is to death. Her own abilities hurt her, but the connection flows both ways — and she intends to make that cost worth it.
Mindbleeder.Weapon Mech: additional damage based on illusory damage on target
Mindbleeder.Major 1: Agony Amplification – Target takes additional illusory damage whenever it is damaged. Requires influence. (Mindbleeder)
Mindbleeder.Major 2: Backbiting Affliction – Affliction on target that deals illusory damage and generates influence on the psychic's turn. Causes physical backbiting to the Mindbleeder each turn. (Mindbleeder)
Mindbleeder.Major 3: Brain Hemorrhage – Causes short duration, high damage illusory damage bleed. (Mindbleeder)
Mindbleeder.Major 4: Echoing Mindblast – Attack target and damage all influenced. (Mindbleeder)
Mindbleeder.Major 5: Ether Razor – Untyped magic attack that causes stacking bleed with stacks and duration enhanced by influence. (Mindbleeder)
Mindbleeder.Major 6: Exploding Skull – Chance to kill target enemy based on illusory damage. On kill, damage all other enemies. (Mindbleeder)
Mindbleeder.Major 7: Feedback Blast – Arcane attack versus all enemies, but triggers feedback at the same time. (Mindbleeder)
Mindbleeder.Major 8: Heart Siphon – Drains life from target and converts it to mana gain. (Mindbleeder)
Mindbleeder.Major 9: Hemokinesis – Possess target bleeding enemy to attack a random enemy. Secondary target takes bleeds based on bleeds present on initial target. (Mindbleeder)
Mindbleeder.Major 10: Illusory Decimation – Deal illusory damage to target based on decimate value. (Mindbleeder)
Mindbleeder.Major 11: Mind Melt – High magic damage against influenced, with effect increased by influence. If this attack kills, feedback consequences are doubled. (Mindbleeder)
Mindbleeder.Major 12: Painful Truth – Deal damage based on influence and illusory. (Mindbleeder)
Mindbleeder.Major 13: Thought Siphon – Drains mana from target and converts it to life gain. (Mindbleeder)
Mindbleeder.Move 1: Bloody Memory – Afflicts target with untyped bleed based on illusory damage currently on it. (Mindbleeder)
Mindbleeder.Move 2: Brain Burst – Whenever the target takes illusory damage before next turn, they also take damage based on their illusory damage total. (Mindbleeder)
Mindbleeder.Move 3: Channeled Exhaustion – Channeled ability that increases the tired value of target. (Mindbleeder)
Mindbleeder.Move 4: Empathic Feedback – Gain pain link with enemies, boosted by influence. (Mindbleeder)
Mindbleeder.Move 5: Feedback Loop – Cause feedback consequences to the Mindbleeder and all influenced enemies. (Mindbleeder)
Mindbleeder.Move 6: Illusory Recovery – Lower illusory damage over time as regeneration. (Mindbleeder)
Mindbleeder.Move 7: Intrusive Painlink – Afflicts both the Mindbleeder and target enemy with pain link that lasts until the end of the Mindbleeder's next turn. (Mindbleeder)
Mindbleeder.Minor 1: Agonizing Thought – Grants next attack this turn a chance to disrupt and stun. (Mindbleeder)
Mindbleeder.Minor 2: Illusory Wildsurge – Randomizes the damage and potency of illusory abilities used by the Mindbleeder, using Wild Surge mechanics. (Mindbleeder)
Mindbleeder.Minor 3: Influential Response – Influence any enemy that damages you until next turn. (Mindbleeder)
Mindbleeder.Minor 4: Mote of Hatred – Negative. Weakens defense of enemies and damages a random enemy on the Mindbleeder's turn based on total influence. (Mindbleeder)
Mindbleeder.Minor 5: Solid Connection – Next ability this turn does not consume influence. (Mindbleeder)
Mindbleeder.Capstone Skill: Morbid Imagination – The Mindbleeder has increased illusory power the closer she is to death, based on the level of this skill.

Chronomancer.Name: Chronomancer
Chronomancer.Description: A spread-influence subclass who bends time itself to delay, rush, and disorient the battlefield. She punishes fast enemies, accelerates allies, and becomes more efficient the more she leans into her hasted or slowed states. Supreme Chronomancy is one of the most powerful single abilities in the psychic tree.
Chronomancer.Major 1: Chronal Bleed – Untyped bleed based on target health and timer. Higher damage to fast targets and longer duration on targets sooner to act. (Chronomancer)
Chronomancer.Major 2: Entropism – Magic attack versus all that deals damage based on the duration and value of bleeds on targets. (Chronomancer)
Chronomancer.Major 3: Entropy Unleashed – Decimate storm attack against random enemies. (Chronomancer)
Chronomancer.Major 4: Gathering Time Storm – Amplified magic attack that damages allies and enemies, delaying enemies and quickening allies. (Chronomancer)
Chronomancer.Major 5: Gravity Blast – Dark magic attack versus all enemies with damage and delay based on how high timers are. (Chronomancer)
Chronomancer.Major 6: Gravity Well – Delay and damage all enemies based on counter above target's counter. (Chronomancer)
Chronomancer.Major 7: Mass Slow – Slow all influenced enemies with standard slow value. Duration scales with influence on each target. (Chronomancer)
Chronomancer.Major 8: Steal Youth – Magic attack that drains life. (Chronomancer)
Chronomancer.Major 9: Supreme Chronomancy – All allies gain an immediate turn. High mana cost. Exhausts the Chronomancer. (Chronomancer)
Chronomancer.Major 10: Temporal Burn – Arcane magic attack enhanced by target's timer. (Chronomancer)
Chronomancer.Major 11: Void Explosion – Magic attack versus all with corrupt and decimate. (Chronomancer)
Chronomancer.Move 1: Greater Haste – Grants haste at a higher value than standard versions. Higher mana cost. (Chronomancer)
Chronomancer.Move 2: Greater Slow – Applies slow at a higher value than standard versions. Higher mana cost. (Chronomancer)
Chronomancer.Move 3: Influence of Time – Gain influence over any enemy affected by haste, slow, or other time conditions. (Chronomancer)
Chronomancer.Move 4: Reverse Timeflow – Reverses the counter of each unit in combat. Prepared. (Chronomancer)
Chronomancer.Move 5: Temporal Barrier – Whenever an enemy attacks the Chronomancer, they are delayed and stunned. (Chronomancer)
Chronomancer.Move 6: Temporal Dissolution – Aura that damages all enemies at the beginning of their turn based on their momentum. (Chronomancer)
Chronomancer.Move 7: Temporal Ripple – Randomize the initiative of all units. (Chronomancer)
Chronomancer.Move 8: Time Stutter – Delays all units, enemies and allies. (Chronomancer)
Chronomancer.Minor 1: Accelerate Bleeding – Increases value of bleeds while reducing their duration. (Chronomancer)
Chronomancer.Minor 2: Accelerate Regeneration – Increases value of regeneration while reducing its duration. (Chronomancer)
Chronomancer.Minor 3: Mote of Hope – Positive. Enhances critical damage of allies and purges a random ally on the Chronomancer's turn based on total influence. (Chronomancer)
Chronomancer.Minor 4: Speed of Thought – Uses mana to quicken self. (Chronomancer)
Chronomancer.Minor 5: Speed Wildsurge – Randomizes the speed of the Chronomancer, using Wild Surge mechanics. (Chronomancer)
Chronomancer.Minor 6: Temporal Blur – Lowers accuracy of target based on their slow value for their next attack. (Chronomancer)
Chronomancer.Capstone Skill: Personal Time – The Chronomancer benefits when either slowed or hasted, with enchantments lasting longer while slower and afflictions fading quicker when hasted.

Puppet Master.Name: Puppet Master
Puppet Master.Description: The pinnacle of possession mastery. She owns enemies outright, bends their will across multiple turns, and profits from every attack they make under her control. Her capstone, Broken Will, ensures that no enemy is ultimately beyond her reach.
Puppet Master.Major 1: Battle of Wills – Long channeled ability that deals arcane damage and possesses target if not disrupted. Deals arcane damage to the Puppet Master if disrupted. (Puppet Master)
Puppet Master.Major 2: Call for Obstruction – Possess an ally and delay an enemy based on the ally's attack. (Puppet Master)
Puppet Master.Major 3: Domination – Possess target enemy. Requires influence. Can be sustained each turn to choose the target of the enemy's possession. Mana cost to sustain reduced based on influence. (Puppet Master)
Puppet Master.Major 4: Ensorcelled Mind – Whenever any enemy attacks the Puppet Master before her next turn, that enemy attacks them in response. (Puppet Master)
Puppet Master.Major 5: Possessive Health – Possess enemy to attack with life drain. All health drained goes to the Puppet Master. Afflicts target with Health Siphon after. (Puppet Master)
Puppet Master.Major 6: Possessive Pain – Possess enemy and cause the damage it deals to be painlinked to all its allies. (Puppet Master)
Puppet Master.Major 7: Puppet Dance – Chance to possess all enemies based on their influence. (Puppet Master)
Puppet Master.Major 8: Repetitive Possession – Possess enemy twice. (Puppet Master)
Puppet Master.Major 9: Suspicion – Possess target. It flanks its target and becomes flanked as well. (Puppet Master)
Puppet Master.Major 10: Unbreakable Strands – High power possession against target. Reduces target's defense against possession effects. (Puppet Master)
Puppet Master.Major 11: Violent Confrontation – Possess target enemy to attack random enemy. That enemy attacks target in response. (Puppet Master)
Puppet Master.Move 1: Mass Influence – Generate influence on all non-influenced enemies. (Puppet Master)
Puppet Master.Move 2: Mass Puppet Strings – Quickens all allies based on total influence. (Puppet Master)
Puppet Master.Move 3: Possession Response – Possess the next enemy to attack the Puppet Master. (Puppet Master)
Puppet Master.Move 4: Sever the String – Target enemy cannot make counter attacks. (Puppet Master)
Puppet Master.Move 5: Touch of Enmity – Target enemy attacks the next other enemy to act. Does not work if target is next to act. (Puppet Master)
Puppet Master.Move 6: Vampiric Possession – Possesses enemy and heals the Puppet Master based on the enemy's damage. Requires influence, mana, and preparation. (Puppet Master)
Puppet Master.Minor 1: Angry Puppet – Enhances damage of target for the next possession attack. (Puppet Master)
Puppet Master.Minor 2: Entangling Strings – Flanks all influenced enemies. (Puppet Master)
Puppet Master.Minor 3: Fiery Mind – Prepared ability that deals fire damage to the next enemy to possess the Puppet Master. (Puppet Master)
Puppet Master.Minor 4: Influential Observation – Alpha and Omega. Gain influence over every enemy that acts between next turn. (Puppet Master)
Puppet Master.Minor 5: Mote of Despair – Negative. Weakens accuracy of enemies and stuns all enemies on the Puppet Master's turn based on total influence. (Puppet Master)
Puppet Master.Minor 6: Painful Possession – Next time target is possessed they take damage based on influence on them. (Puppet Master)
Puppet Master.Minor 7: Possession Wildsurge – Randomizes the power and potency of possession abilities used by the Puppet Master, using Wild Surge mechanics. (Puppet Master)
Puppet Master.Minor 8: Puppet String – Quickens ally based on total influence. (Puppet Master)
Puppet Master.Capstone Skill: Broken Will – The Psychic lowers possession resistance and ignore possession by a percentage based on this skill level.

Abjurer.Name: Abjurer
Abjurer.Capstone Skill: Double Defense Procs – Whenever a defense proc or runes triggers on the unit, it has a chance to trigger twice.

Symbolist.Name: Symbolist
Symbolist.Weapon Mech: next attack deals extra fire damage

Cabalist.Name: Cabalist
Cabalist.Capstone Skill: Know Your Master – Companions will not attack the Cabalist, and have a chance not to attack other party members.

Disenchanter.Name: Disenchanter
Disenchanter.Weapon Mech: chance to proc disenchant on attack

Sage.Name: Sage
Sage.Capstone Skill: Prismatic Magic – The Sage has a chance to create a random prism when this proc triggers.

Glyphic.Name: Glyphic
Glyphic.Weapon Mech: critical multiplier applies to damage adds on critical
Glyphic.Capstone Skill: Double Attack Procs – Whenever an attack proc or rune triggers on the unit, it has a chance to trigger twice.

Cryptic.Name: Cryptic
Cryptic.Weapon Mech: deals portion of countdown damage present on target
Cryptic.Capstone Skill: Remnants of Fate - Whenever a countdown triggers, the Cryptic gains mana.

Sorcerer.Name: Sorcerer
Sorcerer.Weapon Mech: damage scales with total mana used
Sorcerer.Capstone Skill: Preemptive Preparation – The Sorcerer begins battle with one random ability prepared.

Cultist.Name: Cultist
Cultist.Description: A team-oriented controller who drains stats from maledicted enemies and redistributes them to allies. She weaponizes possession and hexes for direct control while her Malign drain suite debilitates entire maledicted groups — and Share in Consumption ensures no drain benefit passes through her hands without leaving something behind.
Cultist.Capstone Skill: Share in Consumption – Whenever a drain ability benefits an ally, the Cultist gets a portion of the effect based on this skill level.

Warlock.Name: Warlock
Warlock.Description: An air-element Witch who turns malediction into a positional weapon. Her whirlwind abilities use a maledicted enemy as an anchor, striking all adjacent foes instead — rewarding grid awareness and central positioning. Bloodlust amplifies her storm attacks while Conductivity makes the entire maledicted field a lightning rod.
Warlock.Capstone Skill: Whirlwind Targeting – The modified skill has a chance to target all enemies adjacent to the original target.

Effigist.Name: Effigist
Effigist.Description: The most aggressive Witch subclass, stacking damage afflictions on targets to fuel piercing effigy attacks that cut through resistance. Flammability turns every fire hit into compounding bleeds, and Personal Effigy rewards taking damage herself — making her a high-risk attacker who burns hotter the more punishment she absorbs.
Effigist.Capstone Skill: Personal Effigy – The Effigist gains increased magic damage for each damage affliction present on her.

Dustbringer.Name: Dustbringer
Dustbringer.Description: A methodical earth-element controller who applies permanent unending afflictions that reserve her mana until enemies die or are purged. She trades mana flexibility for devastating long-term debilitation, and Mana From Dust recycles her investment when corruption finishes the job.
Dustbringer.Weapon Mech: bonus damage based on corruption on target
Dustbringer.Capstone Skill: Mana From Dust - Whenever the Dustbringer kills an enemy with corruption, she recovers mana based on that corruption.

Crone.Name: Crone
Crone.Description: A water-element specialist who deals increased damage and effects in inverse proportion to enemy speed — making her strongest against the foes she has already slowed. Chill to Frost converts redundant slows into hard incapacitation, and Inspiring Misfortune makes her one of the strongest mana generators in the entire Witch family.
Crone.Weapon Mech: bonus damage based on target's slow value
Crone.Capstone Skill: Chill to Frost - Whenever an enemy would be slowed enemy is slowed again, it is instead incapacitated.

Hedgemage.Name: Hedgemage
Hedgemage.Description: A chaotic generalist who trades reliability for volume, deploying cheap bewitch afflictions against maledicted enemies at reduced action cost. Agnostic Afflictions removes elemental opposition penalties on vulnerability and exposure, letting her stack conditions freely regardless of enemy resistances — chaos as a feature, not a flaw.
Hedgemage.Weapon Mech: last action each turn has improved magic power
Hedgemage.Capstone Skill: Agnostic Afflictions – The Hedgemage ignores the opposing element penalty for vulnerability and exposure effects she applies. These effects retain full value even against resistances that would normally reduce them, as if the element were neutral.

Mambo.Name: Mambo
Mambo.Description: A light-element support Witch who harvests fetishes from fallen enemies and deploys them as stat-scaling ally buffs. She transfers afflictions from allies to enemies, drains life, and accumulates mana through Fetish Bag by holding fetishes in reserve — balancing the tension between deploying her toolkit and sustaining herself.
Mambo.Weapon Mech: improved heal and purge per affliction on ally
Mambo.Capstone Skill: Fetish Bag – The Witch Doctor gains increased mana generation for each fetish currently held and not yet deployed. The bonus scales with the number of undeployed fetishes.

Bokor.Name: Bokor
Bokor.Description: A dark necromancer who builds zombie companions from killed and afflicted enemies, using Juju Curse to turn her entire malediction toolkit into a zombie pipeline. Corpse Pile makes each death — enemy or companion — strengthen her current zombie, turning attrition into escalating companion power.
Bokor.Weapon Mech: damage dealt heals companion by small percentage
Bokor.Capstone Skill: Corpse Pile – Whenever another companion would be generated or would die, the Bokor's current zombie companion restores health and gains increased maximum health.

Hag.Name: Hag
Hag.Description: A corruption and bleed specialist who wraps her worst afflictions in criterion shells that resist purging until they deal their full damage. Expiration Surge turns every naturally expiring condition into mana, rewarding patience and long-duration stacking — Plague Cauldron's exponential corruption release is her most catastrophic payoff for waiting.
Hag.Weapon Mech: increased affliction power per affliction on self
Hag.Capstone Skill: Expiration Surge – Whenever any affliction on any enemy expires naturally, the Hag generates mana. Criteria that complete their damage threshold generate a larger mana bonus.

Malefax.Name: Malefax
Malefax.Description: The apex Witch, combining covenants, curses, and mass malediction into a comprehensive affliction dominance platform. She channels malediction across entire enemy groups with Malefaction Chant, unifies damage through Sympathy, and elevates her whole party's affliction pressure through Cursed Amplification — the Witch's toolkit at its most absolute.
Malefax.Capstone Skill: Cursed Amplification – Increases the potency and power of all afflictions used against cursed enemies. This applies to afflictions used by any ally, not just the Malefax.

Elementalist.Name: Elementalist
Elementalist.Description: All-elements generalist with companion support and momentum-driven efficiency. She cycles through every element in sequence to build stacking cast speed and mana bonuses, summons earth and water elementals, and infuses allies with elemental damage adds — the most versatile and accessible wizard subclass.
Elementalist.Capstone Skill: Elemental Momentum — Each time the Elementalist uses an ability with a different element than the previous elemental ability, she gains a stacking bonus to cast speed and reduced mana cost. The stack resets to zero when she repeats an element from her current set.

Necromancer.Name: Necromancer
Necromancer.Description: Dark magic specialist who turns death itself into a resource. She raises skeletal companions, scales her storm damage to the body count, and runs a suite of prepared abilities that trigger automatically when enemies fall — rewarding her for battles where allies are doing the killing as much as her own.
Necromancer.Capstone Skill: Kill Steal — The Necromancer's kill skills have a chance to activate when allied units kill enemies.

Hydromancer.Name: Hydromancer
Hydromancer.Description: Control-focused water specialist with the deepest incapacitation toolkit in the class. She freezes, slows, and delays entire battlefields, with her most powerful conflux ability scaling both the number of targets incapacitated and how hard they are to wake based on how many elements she has charged.
Hydromancer.Capstone Skill: Water Mastery – Water spells cost less mana and cast quicker.

Geomancer.Name: Geomancer
Geomancer.Description: Defensive earth specialist who protects allies while grinding down enemy defenses. She builds damage shields, roots enemies in place, and applies layered weaknesses — her conflux abilities uniquely favor the whole party by granting elemental retaliations and stacking debuffs across every stat.
Geomancer.Capstone Skill: Earth Mastery – Earth spells cost less mana and cast quicker.

Aeromancer.Name: Aeromancer
Aeromancer.Description: High-variance air specialist built around storm damage and stun pressure. She thrives on randomness — chaining lightning across the grid, forking attacks into splits, and stacking storm hits to overwhelm enemies — with the highest individual damage ceiling in the class when lucky damage and maximum damage align.
Aeromancer.Capstone Skill: Air Mastery – Air spells cost less mana and cast quicker.

Pyromancer.Name: Pyromancer
Pyromancer.Description: Area fire specialist who hits everyone, repeatedly. She applies countdowns, causes wounds, and commits fully to upfront mana costs for abilities that pay off over multiple ticks — Catastrophe and Conflux Meteor reward planning several turns ahead and punish enemies who cannot interrupt her.
Pyromancer.Capstone Skill: Fire Mastery – Fire spells cost less mana and cast quicker.

Arcanist.Name: Arcanist
Arcanist.Description: Anti-attunement specialist who grows stronger the more completely she clears her elemental slate. She is the only wizard whose peak performance comes after spending conflux rather than before it, with her most powerful abilities gating behind having no attunements and her conflux damage rewarding precise elemental power investment over breadth.
Arcanist.Capstone Skill: Arcane Conversion – When the modified skill is triggered, the damage type has a chance to be converted to arcane.

Solomancer.Name: Solomancer
Solomancer.Description: Light magic specialist with hex, justice, and a unique mana economy identity. She wants enemies casting expensive spells so her Mana Disparity bonus peaks, making her the only wizard who benefits from enemy casters. Her full-conflux Conflux Enchantment can grant the entire party six simultaneous buffs scaled to her elemental investment.
Solomancer.Capstone Skill: Mana Disparity — Increases magic power based on the difference between the target's current mana and the Solomancer's current mana. Checked before the ability's mana cost is spent.

Incanter.Name: Incanter
Incanter.Description: Reactive counterspell specialist who punishes enemy spellcasting while sustaining channeled damage. She runs a suite of prepared counterspells that can chain indefinitely, drains mana from enemies, and uses Conflux Channeling to chain successive elemental damage sequences — the only wizard subclass that gets stronger the more the enemy commits to magic.
Incanter.Capstone Skill: Reflected Counterspell — Prepared ability that counters an enemy spell and deals magic damage to the caster and random enemies based on the countered spell's mana cost.

Thaumaturge.Name: Thaumaturge
Thaumaturge.Description: Pinnacle attunement-breadth specialist who rewards deliberate, expensive play. She wants all six elements charged simultaneously, spends them through Supreme abilities that scale with attunement count, and uses her previous turn's mana expenditure to amplify the next — the most technically demanding wizard subclass and the one with the highest ceiling.
Thaumaturge.Capstone Skill: Arcane Expenditure — Enhances the magic power of all abilities used on the next turn based on total mana spent on the current turn.
